programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

programme.title: Bandits
programme.desc: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

programme.title: Ronin
programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: The Hot Spot
programme.desc: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

programme.title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
programme.desc: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

programme.title: The Crocodile Hunter: Collision Course
programme.desc: Steve and Terri Irwin set out to save a crocodile, unaware that it’s swallowed a U.S. satellite beacon, and now they’re targets of the CIA! Crikey!

programme.title: Futureworld
programme.desc: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…

programme.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
programme.desc: In this cult classic, neurosurgeon, physicist and rock star Buckaroo Banzai (Peter Weller) is ready to save the world when the evil Red Lectroids -- led by the deranged Lord John Whorfin (John Lithgow) -- are unleashed from the 8th dimension.

programme.title: Cherry 2000
programme.desc: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Set against the wondrous backdrop of the Great Pyramids, "Stargate" tells the story of two very different men (Kurt Russell, James Spader) who join forces to unravel the mystery of a curious artifact which could reveal the origin of civilization.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Detective Jack Caine (Dolph Lundgren) thought he;d dealt with every kind of crime on earth, but someone "or something" is using human bodies to manufacture narcotics.

programme.title: Enter The Ninja
programme.desc: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

programme.title: Revenge Of The Ninja
programme.desc: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

programme.title: Ninja III: The Domination
programme.desc: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

programme.title: Running Scared
programme.desc: Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: Warriors Of Virtue
programme.desc: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

programme.title: Walking Tall: The Payback
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

programme.title: Malone
programme.desc: Ex-CIA agent (Burt Reynolds) has his quiet life disrupted when he stumbles onto a military conspiracy led by a rightwing zealot (Cliff Robertson).

programme.title: White Lightning
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

programme.title: Gator
programme.desc: The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

programme.title: Convoy
programme.desc: Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: The Born Losers
programme.desc: When a vicious motorcycle gang launches an assault on a small town and a local girl (Elizabeth James), Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) goes on a one-man crusade to save the town and the girl! The first of the wildly successful Billy Jack feature films.

programme.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
programme.desc: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

programme.title: The Glory Stompers
programme.desc: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

programme.title: The Wild Angels
programme.desc: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

programme.desc: Set against the 1912 Mexican Revolution, Captain Rod Douglas (George Peppard) leads a small band of misfits into Mexican territory to destroy six cannons, stolen by bloodthirsty revolutionaries and their infamous leader Hector Cordoba (Raf Vallone).

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Gunslinger
programme.desc: When the town marshal is gunned down, his wife Rose (Beverly Garland) dons his badge. But now an evil dancehall diva (Allison Hayes) wants her dead and hires a gunslinger (John Ireland), who agrees to kill Rose...until he falls in love with her!

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: Red River
programme.desc: John Wayne, Montgomery Clift and Walter Brennan give stellar performances in Howard Hawks' epic masterpiece as a self-made cattle baron (Wayne) and his adopted son (Clift) risk everything to drive their herd across the treacherous Chisholm Trail.

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: John Wayne teams with William Holden and director John Ford for this rousing tale of one of the most daring cavalry exploits in all of history.

programme.title: The Alamo
programme.desc: John Wayne produces, directs and stars in this retelling of the Alamo, a battle in which 185 men joined together against an army of 7,000. Filmed entirely in Texas, "The Alamo" is a visually stunning and historically accurate celebration of courage.

programme.title: The Missouri Breaks
programme.desc: In their only screen pairing, legends Marlon Brando and Jack Nicholson set the screen ablaze as a bounty hunter and his horse-thieving prey in director Arthur Penn's intense and startlingly realistic western classic! Harry Dean Stanton co-stars.

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: Fort Defiance
programme.desc: In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.

programme.title: Terror In A Texas Town
programme.desc: In this compelling and imaginative western, a peace-loving Swedish seaman is forced to take on an entire frontier town when he discovers a ruthless oil prospector has been forcing farmers to sell their land...or pay for it with their lives.

programme.title: Day Of The Outlaw
programme.desc: In this stark, unconventional and powerful western, a ruthless rancher (Robert Ryan) must find a way to save the town of Bitters, Wyoming, its citizenry, and his own soul when a gang of outlaws rides into town. Burl Ives and Tina Louise also star.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory – and a cunning woman – to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: The Gunfight At Dodge City
programme.desc: Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

programme.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
programme.desc: In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!

programme.title: The Spikes Gang
programme.desc: Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

programme.title: Dances With Wolves
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

programme.title: Wild Bill
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Wild Bill Hickok, the hard-drinking, quick-shooting gunslinger who lived on the edge. Hickok's amazing story is told with a stunning visual style, illuminating one of the most exciting heroes of the American West.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: Mario Van Peebles and Billy Zane shake up the frontier in this gun-blazing, fist-pounding western that takes a page missing from the history books and unfolds it with suspense, humor and awe-inspiring power! Pam Grier and Isaac Hayes co-star.

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: Cast A Long Shadow
programme.desc: Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: When a Mexican gunslinger (Anthony Quinn) rids a town of several notorious gunfighters, he is named the sheriff, but must win over the rest of the residents who are yet to warm to his hard-hitting ways. Katy Jurado and Peter Whitney co-star.

programme.title: Gun The Man Down
programme.desc: When an outlaw is shot during a heist and left for dead by his partners - who take his money and his woman - he sets out to track them down. And when he catches up with them, he'll have to rely on his wits...as much as the loaded gun in his holster!

programme.title: Man With The Gun
programme.desc: As a gang of brutal gunmen forcefully gain control of Sheridan City, its terrified citizens hire the notorious "town-tamer" Clint Tollinger to help them. But Tollinger operates in his own way...so things could get a lot worse before they get better!

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: Sam Whiskey
programme.desc: Welcome to America's Wild - and very wacky - West! Burt Reynolds, Clint Walker, Ossie Davis and Angie Dickinson star in this tongue-in-cheek tale of love, lust and larceny as an amiable con-artist is hire by a sexy widow to break into the U.S. Mint.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: Jesse James and his gang ride again! David , Keith and Robert Carradine; James and Stacy Keach; Randy and Dennis Quaid; Christopher and Nicholas Guest depict real-life siblings in this charged portrayal of the Old West's legendary bandits.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In March 2014, authorities found severely malnourished 5-year-old Jordan Bleimeyer after he allegedly had been locked inside a small closet under the stairs of a Houston-area home. His father, Bradley, and stepmother, Tammi, were arrested and charged with felony child endangerment. In an exclusive interview, Tammi breaks her silence -- why does she say she had no idea what was happening to her stepson?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The siblings of 5-year-old Jordan Bleimeyer, who was held captive in a tiny cubbyhole under the stairs, starved and abused by his father and stepmother, reveal how they sneaked Jordan food and freed him from his closet prison, saving his life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Surgeon General’s Advisory stated, before the COVID-19 pandemic, mental health challenges were the leading cause of disability and poor life outcomes in young people. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

He starts to question his values, his lifestyle choices and his relationship with Marion and even suspects her of starting an affair with Toni whom she dislikes! programme.desc: When Veronika Daniels's co-host leaves "Rise and Shine," she opens auditions for replacements, including Charlie Fisher, a seasoned NY newscaster, and Emily Morgan, a spirited human interest reporter. Emily's unexpected viral plea for the job intensifies the competition. As they vie for the role leading up to the Christmas Day Telethon, old romantic feelings between Charlie and Emily resurface, adding a new layer of complexity to their professional rivalry.

programme.title: Jingle Belle
programme.desc: Every year, high school sweethearts Isabelle and Mike delighted their small town with a Christmas duet at the annual Christmas Eve Pageant. After graduation, Isabelle left for Juilliard, leaving Mike behind. Years later, she returns home to write music for the beloved pageant and discovers Mike is directing the show. As old feelings resurface, they must put the past behind them and decide if they can make beautiful music together again.

programme.title: My Christmas Inn
programme.desc: With Christmas in full swing, Jen is on the verge of a major promotion at her San Francisco ad agency when she unexpectedly inherits a cozy inn in Alaska. Traveling north to inspect the property, she meets charming local attorney Brian and discovers a welcoming town filled with festive traditions. As she embraces the magic of the season, Jen begins to wonder if the inn—and a new romance—might offer the life she's been searching for.

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: The Christmas Checklist
programme.desc: Emily is faced with the daunting task of fulfilling her late mother Ruby’s last wish – a twelve-task Christmas Checklist. With local freelance writer Noah covering her compelling story, his article turns from inspiring to cherished just in time for Christmas Eve, as their journey together reveals that Ruby’s final wish has been in front of them the whole time.

programme.title: A Christmas Castle Proposal: A Royal In Paradise 2
programme.desc: Olivia meets charming Alexander on the tropical Haven Isles, unaware he’s a prince. As they explore the island, friendship turns to romance—until a royal spy reveals his identity. Invited to spend Christmas at his majestic palace, Olivia faces royal traditions, strict protocol, and comedic culture clashes. Amid the chaos, love is tested, but a magical Christmas might bring the proposal of a lifetime.

programme.title: Christmas A La Mode
programme.desc: Emily is determined to fulfil her father�s wishes to save the family dairy farm which has been financially struggling for years. When a handsome stranger, Charlie, shows up at Emily�s family dairy farm at Christmastime, Emily has to hide her feelings for him when he turns out to be her sister�s partner and they are there to sell the farm. Can Emily get her Christmas miracle to save the family farm and win the handsome guy in the end?

programme.title: A Christmas in Vermont
programme.desc: Riley Thomas is sent by her profit-obsessed boss to shut down one of the company's holdings, a small outerwear company in Vermont, for missing profit targets. Riley finds that the company is the lifeblood of a town and, instead of closing down the iconic firm, she unexpectedly falls in love and learns valuable lessons beyond the bottom line.

programme.title: Holly and the Hot Chocolate
programme.desc: Big-city food critic Holly finds herself stranded in the Christmas-obsessed town of Pine Falls. Amid the festive town square, she uncovers the warmth of community, the magic of an extraordinary hot chocolate, and the transformative power of love. This unexpected detour turns her life upside down and opens her heart to new possibilities.

programme.title: The Spirit of Christmas Station
programme.desc: With a Christmas deadline fast approaching, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family’s mountain cabin in search of inspiration for the story she can’t seem to finish. When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas
programme.desc: When Prancer injures his hoof Santa’s stable hand, John, must find a fill in to ensure Christmas deliveries go off without a hitch. His mission gets complicated when he discovers that Frankie, the perfect substitute reindeer, belongs to a precocious 8-year-old girl and her mother Annie. As he races to get Frankie up to the North Pole, he realizes that he’s actually falling in love with Annie and has to find a way to win her over and save Christmas at the same time.

programme.title: Too Close for Christmas
programme.desc: High-powered event planner Hayley Parker heads to the mountains for a quiet Christmas with her sister Amy, brother-in-law Tim, and his family—only to find Tim’s charming brother Paul is joining too. Hayley blames Paul for her last breakup and plans to keep her distance. But when Amy pleads for peace, Hayley agrees to play nice—only to discover there may be more to Paul than she thought.

programme.title: A Very Married Christmas
programme.desc: A quiet, ordinary man sees his comfortable life turned upside down at Christmas when he discovers his wife is having an affair and wants a divorce. Suddenly facing the holidays alone, he struggles to find any reason to celebrate. But an unexpected friendship with a kindhearted volunteer Santa helps him rediscover hope, joy and the magic of the season, leading him on a heartfelt journey toward healing, new possibilities and a Christmas miracle he never saw coming.

programme.title: Wrapped Up in Christmas
programme.desc: Heather, a hardworking mall manager, must make tough holiday cuts—including ending leases on struggling stores—to earn a promotion. Focused on her career, she’s given up on love, but her spirited niece Molly hasn’t. Molly asks the mall Santa for a Christmas boyfriend for Heather—unaware he’s actually Ryan, a mall worker secretly helping his aunt’s failing toy shop. Can love survive their hidden truths?

programme.title: The Art of Christmas
programme.desc: After her latest gallery exhibition unexpectedly gets cancelled, struggling artist Liv James accepts a teaching job at a local elementary school to make ends meet. Liv meets Jake Hartley, who helps her learn the ropes and through this new experience, she rediscovers why she became an artist, a new sense of purpose and a surprising romance.

programme.title: Christmas Keepsake
programme.desc: Single father, Tom and his daughter, Grace make the big move from the sunny land of Australia to the quaint US town of Ashbury Grove. While exploring her new backyard, Grace finds a mysterious time capsule, containing a guide to a perfect family Christmas. The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

programme.title: A Christmas Post
programme.desc: Noah Harrington is hired to revitalize a reluctant small town. When he finds undelivered Santa letters from the 1990s, he teams up with local historian Tessa Findlay to track down the long-lost gifts and bring early Christmas joy. As sparks fly between them, Noah hides one letter—Tessa’s childhood wish to ring the town’s Christmas bell before the post office is demolished. Can he save the bell, his job, and their budding romance in time?

programme.title: Christmas at the Amish Bakery

Determined, Lori travels to his hometown, Hudson, Wisconsin, but loses hope seeing other women there for the same reason. Fate brings them together, but Lori hides her true intentions, fearing she might lose him when the truth comes out.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Hope

Still grieving her husband, she fights to keep hope alive—especially through her non-profit work and the annual tree lighting. Across the ocean, Prince Christopher escapes royal duties for a break in the U.S. When a chance meeting sparks connection, their bond deepens, and secrets and holiday pressures force them to face what truly matters.

programme.title: A Holiday for Love
programme.desc: A man is sent to a small town to assess which of the workers in the local factory that supplies the town with jobs should get the boot when the downsizing begins. He gets sidetracked when he falls in love with a local, single mom.

programme.title: I'll Be Home for Christmas
programme.desc: Veterinarian and part-time mayor Sarah heads a town council desperate to find a doctor to keep open the town's clinic. Their hopes are raised when a surgeon plans to visit for the first time in years for the Christmas holiday. The mayor's attempt to recruit the surgeon is complicated by their history (their high school romance) and his secret shame (that he has lost his confidence in his surgical skills in the big city hospital in which he works).

programme.title: Too Close for Christmas
programme.desc: High-powered event planner Hayley Parker heads to the mountains for a quiet Christmas with her sister Amy, brother-in-law Tim, and his family—only to find Tim’s charming brother Paul is joining too. Hayley blames Paul for her last breakup and plans to keep her distance. But when Amy pleads for peace, Hayley agrees to play nice—only to discover there may be more to Paul than she thought.

programme.title: A Christmas Village
programme.desc: Piper Jansen is a slick public relations genius and owner of her own company "Piper's Picks." After creating countless successful campaigns, she decides to use her grandmother's holiday recipes to write and launch a book of her own but, suddenly finds herself in the middle of a very public scandal that threatens the launch of the book as well as her business.

programme.title: Holiday Road Trip
programme.desc: Two employees at a high-profile pet store become mismatched travel companions when they find themselves on the road together at Christmastime for a social media tour with the company mascot, a dog named Scoots.

programme.title: The Christmas Bookshop
programme.desc: A perfectionist holiday expert and a free-spirited bookstore owner find themselves in a spirited rivalry when a festive bet challenges them to prove whose approach to Christmas is truly the best. As they compete—her meticulous traditions against his carefree creativity—the town gets swept up in their holiday showdown. But amid twinkling lights, laughter, and unexpected sparks, they soon realize that love and compromise might be the real holiday magic.

programme.title: Christmas A La Mode
programme.desc: Emily is determined to fulfil her father�s wishes to save the family dairy farm which has been financially struggling for years. When a handsome stranger, Charlie, shows up at Emily�s family dairy farm at Christmastime, Emily has to hide her feelings for him when he turns out to be her sister�s partner and they are there to sell the farm. Can Emily get her Christmas miracle to save the family farm and win the handsome guy in the end?

programme.title: The Spirit of Christmas Station
programme.desc: With a Christmas deadline fast approaching, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family’s mountain cabin in search of inspiration for the story she can’t seem to finish. When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Runaway
programme.desc: Maggie Colby runs away from her own wedding when she has doubts that she really loves her fiance, Douglas Wilshire. She tries to sort out her feelings while trapped by a blizzard in a lodge with her Grandmother and ex-boyfriend Colt. Will she get back with Colt or return to Douglas?

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: Sharing Christmas
programme.desc: A real estate developer gets the chance of a lifetime to transform an old shopping complex into a luxury hotspot. But his plans hit a snag when the last holdout is the charming owner of a year-round Christmas shop—someone he unexpectedly connected with just days earlier. As he tries to win her over professionally, he finds himself falling for her and questioning everything he thought he wanted.

programme.title: The Christmas Listing
programme.desc: Julia Rogers, an uptight, hardworking realty owner who’s lost her Christmas spirit, must spend five days at a festive Christmas Inn with her business rival, Chad Everest, to secure the coveted Erickson Farmstead listing. As their competition heats up, unexpected sparks fly, and Julia and Chad discover they share more in common than rivalry, finding that friendship—and maybe even love—can bloom amid holiday cheer.

programme.title: A Cherry Pie Christmas
programme.desc: A talented pastry chef returns to her hometown in Door County, WI, for the holidays, only to find herself torn between pursuing her dream job in the city or preserving her family’s cherished cherry orchard. With the orchard’s future uncertain, a lost cherry pie recipe, and the unexpected reappearance of her high school sweetheart, she must rediscover what truly matters—and decide if love and tradition can guide her future.

programme.title: The Spirit of Christmas Station
programme.desc: With a Christmas deadline fast approaching, literary editor Isabell retreats to her family’s mountain cabin in search of inspiration for the story she can’t seem to finish. When she arrives, she discovers the once-charming town is struggling, its beloved Christmas Festival on the verge of being canceled. With the help of a kindhearted local rancher, Isabell sets out to revive the holiday spirit—and along the way, finds not only the heart of the town but also the perfect ending to her own story.

Hayley blames Paul for her last breakup and plans to keep her distance. But when Amy pleads for peace, Hayley agrees to play nice—only to discover there may be more to Paul than she thought.

programme.title: A Holiday for Love
programme.desc: A man is sent to a small town to assess which of the workers in the local factory that supplies the town with jobs should get the boot when the downsizing begins. He gets sidetracked when he falls in love with a local, single mom.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Ball
programme.desc: Dateless for the Christmas ball, bachelor King Charles of Baltania tracks down Allison, his American college sweetheart, only to discover she has never been married, yet raised a 17-year-old daughter, Lily, who mathematically might be Charles' child.

programme.title: A Christmas in Royal Fashion
programme.desc: When a talented assistant meets a handsome young prince in disguise, he is instantly smitten with her, mistaking her as the boss. As their relationship grows and the truth is revealed, she wonders if he would have still fallen for her if he knew she was an assistant, and not the boss.

programme.title: My Christmas Prince
programme.desc: Samantha, a dedicated teacher, heads home for Christmas with her boyfriend Alex, whom she believes is a diplomat. But holiday cheer turns to royal chaos when she discovers he’s actually the heir to the throne of Madelvia. With his disapproving royal parents and her own dreams on the line, Samantha must decide if love is worth giving up everything she’s worked for to become a queen.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Engagement
programme.desc: Lauren, a hard-working advertising executive, begins to fall for Paul, a consultant she has been paired with to land a big account for the upcoming holiday season. Unbeknownst to Lauren and everyone else, Paul is actually Prince Edward Charles, European royalty in disguise as a commoner.

programme.title: A Prince and Pauper Christmas
programme.desc: Sydney, a go-getting federal agent, finds out that her down-on-his luck confidential informant in a criminal investigation suddenly goes missing, she begins a desperate scramble to continue her investigation. However, her luck hasn’t run out yet when she finds a man who is her informant's mirror image. She recruits this doppelgänger to play his role.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
programme.desc: The holiday season is alive in New York, where a ballet rehearsal for The Nutcracker is underway. Carrie, the prima ballerina, focuses on guiding the young dancers around her. Meanwhile, Prince William is tasked with escorting Medea, a rising star ballerina, to New York. Medea's arrival disrupts the growing bond between Carrie and the Prince. When Medea is injured, the question arises: will Carrie step in to save the performance? Christmas magic may lead to more than just a show.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Manor
programme.desc: Prince Alexander of Fredonia, weary of his royal duties, escapes to America for Christmas, checking into a struggling inn under a false identity. Katie, the inn’s charming owner, welcomes Alex with open arms, unaware of his true status. As they share festive moments and grow closer, their bond deepens. But when Alex’s secret is revealed, Katie must decide if love is worth the risk of living in the royal spotlight.

programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society investigate a suspected haunting in an old multi-use church. However, the investigation takes an unexpected emotional turn as they connect with a surprising spirit. What begins as a typical haunting becomes deeply personal, and the team moves from assumption to affirmation—all caught on camera.

Martins develops a conspiracy theory after learning of a "third man" present at the time of Harry's death, running into interference from British officer Major Calloway, and falling head-over-heels for Harry's grief-stricken lover, Anna.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.title: Meli
programme.desc: After finding an eviction notice on her door, Meli decides it’s time to up the ante and take matters into her own hands to protect her family by any means necessary. Out of pure desperation she attempts to burglarize a stranger’s luxurious home.

programme.title: How Did We Get Here
programme.desc: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity, Omar and Sonya struggle with commitment, Chastity and Monae have differing opinions on parenthood, and Stephanie and Delvin are struggling with their intimacy. As the couples dive into their treatment, they must confront their own demons to move forward. Will they make it out together? Or go their separate ways?

programme.title: Nothing Even Matters
programme.desc: Paroled after 5 years for a victimless crime, Travis is taken in by an acquaintance, Benny, and her mother. Their generosity turns into a life of crime and murder. As he falls for a woman named Bear, Travis must escape the web of secrets and lies he's trapped in, fighting for survival and the love he's found.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: The Other Sister
programme.desc: After ending her relationship to focus on her future, a driven young woman invites her troubled sister to move in for a fresh start. But as boundaries begin to blur, jealousy turns into obsession, and trust quickly unravels. When secrets come to light, she must confront a chilling truth. Sometimes the biggest threat isn’t a stranger. It’s family.

programme.title: Brick Nash
programme.desc: Brick Nash returns home after several years following his father’s mysterious death, hoping to solve the mystery of his death. What begins as a search for answers quickly pulls him into a dangerous world of hidden money, violent criminals, and powerful people with secrets they’ll do anything to protect.

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: The Seeds of Violence 1918-1922
programme.desc: Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.

programme.title: Deceit and Delusion 1923-1928
programme.desc: Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.

programme.title: Democracy without Democrats 1929-1933
programme.desc: In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.

programme.title: The Racial State 1933-1934
programme.desc: After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.

programme.title: Hidden in Plain Sight 1935-1938
programme.desc: In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.

programme.title: Up in Flames 1936-1940
programme.desc: At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.

programme.title: Auschwitz One Day
programme.desc: Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.

programme.title: The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
programme.desc: "The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Concrete Against Bombs
programme.desc: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.

programme.title: Facing Nuclear Annihilation
programme.desc: The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.desc: When the Young Peoples Agricultural Society holds their annual convention in Washington, D.C., local members Eb, Mr. Kimball, and Arnold the pig get ready to make the big trip. Oliver and Lisa serve as unintended chaperones.

programme.desc: While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.desc: Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

programme.desc: Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.

programme.desc: Mr. Haney and Fred Ziffel try to persuade Oliver to invest in a new business venture. "Looney Luke" Needlinger claim to have invented a machine that can turn hay into fresh milk. Oliver is skeptical and tries to prove the machine is a white lie.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa's "Mudder" pays a surprise visit to Lisa and Oliver. Eb good-naturedly introduces her as the Queen of Sicily. As a result, the entire town treats her like royalty. They even go so far as to hold a special day in her honor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold Ziffel, Hooterville's beloved swine is thought to have rightful claim to a $20,000 fortune. The Birnbacher pork empire has promised that the descendant of the famous weather-predicting pig, Herman, will inherit the vast sum.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver, Lisa and Eb travel to Chicago with Arnold to prove the pig is the rightful heir to the Birnbacher pork empire. Will this pig get rich? Arnold makes a surprising prediction that baffles all, including all the lawyers involved.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver returns home with Arnold, the citizens in town hold a large reception for Arnold. But when Oliver receives a phone call from a lawyer representing an eccentric relative of the Birnbachers, the riches go into question.

programme.desc: Oliver is mad over the town's dirt road, especially when he finds out that the state set aside money over thirty years ago to fix it. Oliver goes to the Capitol to get the road paved but hits a roadblock when the Ziffels' house must be torn down.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa foretells of a mysterious stranger that will appear into Oliver's life. Enter Tadpole Talbot, Eb's childhood friend who has become a singing sensation. Tadpole has convinced Eb to go out on the road with him and join his band as a roadie.

programme.desc: Oliver become alarmed that the youth of his beloved town, Hooterville is dwindling so he calls an emergency town meeting to prevent them from leaving. The next thing Oliver knows is that his barn has been volunteered for the new youth center.

programme.desc: Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.

programme.desc: Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver and Lisa discover a root cellar under their house and become trapped when it collapses in on them. Their only hope to get rescued rides on a hilarious game of charades between Arnold the pig and Mr. Drucker.

programme.desc: Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

programme.desc: Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

programme.desc: Oliver's crops are getting stomped on by Irene the cow. In his frustration, he fires a shotgun to scare Irene away. Instead the blast leads to a hilarious misunderstanding among Lisa, Eb and a life-sized fiberglass cow.

programme.desc: Oliver has become the new School Board President. Unfortunately, Oliver's first day on the job is anything but smooth. Arnold the pig is expelled from his duties as the school's mascot, and Fred Ziffel implores Oliver to defend Arnold.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After receiving a tax refund from the IRS, Oliver inspires his fellow citizens to make similar requests. There's only one problem... those making requests haven't paid their taxes! Nevertheless, the IRS mistakenly sends out half a million dollars!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is insistent that he and Lisa have a romantic Sunday afternoon picnic, all alone. His romantic gesture for two turns into a picnic for the entire town. Finally, Oliver finds them a romantic refuge in a most unlikely place.

programme.desc: Local boy Dinky Watson has one heck of a story to tell anyone who will listen. When Dinky convinces Lisa to buy a "moon rock" for the considerable sum of $14, Oliver suspects that she is the victim of a practical joke.

programme.desc: There is the old adage that warns never to discuss politics with your spouse... but what if you are both running for the same office?! That predicament comes true when Oliver and Lisa face each other in the Hooterville mayoral election.

programme.desc: Lisa and Oliver try to sort out of the troubles of fools in love. The problems begin when Eb invites both his girlfriend and another young woman to the same dance, while Arnold the pig falls for not one, but two attractive bovines.

programme.desc: Oliver is having a tough time. He has no one to help him pick the apples from his orchard, and he's promised to teach Lisa how to drive. The neighbors are all injured from assisting other harvests, and Lisa has a run-in with a sheriff.

programme.desc: Eb feels the time is right to settle down and marry Darlene. However, he has nowhere near the money it will take to make a down payment on a house. With the help of the Douglases, who have given him two acres of land, Eb applies for a loan.

programme.desc: Eb believes he has found his destiny when an accounting course he has enrolled in turns out to be acting workshop. All the world's a stage. Ed dives into acting and turns every simple interaction at the Douglas farm into a starring role.

programme.desc: After Lisa attends a Women's Liberation League meeting, she gives Oliver a scolding for denying her equal rights and demands to swap chores. While Lisa does a stellar job at Oliver's work, Oliver's attempts at hers leave something to be desired.

programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to New York City to attend the wedding anniversary of an old friend. Meanwhile, Eb, always up to something, has a new invisible friend named Charlie. To get her way, Lisa introduces her own invisible friend... Natasha.

programme.desc: Lisa gives the financially-challenged Eb her engagement ring to present to Darlene, his longtime sweetheart, so that he can pop the question. The ring is reportedly valued at $2,000, however, when Darlene's father has it appraised, it's a shocker.

programme.desc: The Douglases are offered a free paint job on their house and barn so long as they allow the paint company free advertising on their barn wall. Meanwhile, Lisa tries to make spaghetti for Oliver's upcoming birthday. Will it prove im-pasta-ble?

programme.desc: Lisa hosts the son of WWII hero Drobny, and all of Hooterville gets excited in anticipation of a surge of tourists. Trouble is, this hero was a duck, as is his son. Oliver tried to warn everyone they were making too much fuss over feathers.

programme.desc: Young lovers Eb and Darlene are just weeks away from their wedding day, but they must choose the marriage venue. It's hard to decide between a church and a car wash. At least it is for Eb, who is still looking for a way to pay for it all.

programme.desc: While staying with the Douglases, Arnold the Pig witnesses a bank robbery when he goes with the Douglases on an errand in Pixley. When Lisa asks him to describe the two robbers, Arnold, reliving the moment, loses his voice from fear.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.
