Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Gerry of Team Psychic's lack of control led to an explosive conclusion when his Cyber Bit Beast blew up. The Blade Breakers were at a loss as to how that could happen so Kenny consulted his trusty laptop Dizzi and made a startling revelation. Someone had managed to make copies of the Blade Breakers Bit Beasts! This discovery leads the gang to believe that new powerful Bit Beasts are being developed and they decide to get themselves in shape for battle. Ozuma and his gang, the Saint Shields, are still eager to test the power of the Blade Breakers' Bit Beasts as well, so they head to the beach where Tyson and the others are training. Meanwhile Doctor B is busy experimenting with various versions of a Cyber Bit Beast with mixed results.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai's classmate Wyatt returns and begs Kai to help him train to become a first-class Beyblader. Remembering the time back at school that Wyatt betrayed Kai by stealing Dranzer and using it in battle, Kai turns him down. Hurt, Wyatt vows to return and battle Kai one day. That day may be sooner than anyone thinks' for the mysterious Dr. B and his team of scientists have finally re-developed the Cyber Bit Beast and are looking for a Blader with the skill to handle it. Dr. B approaches Wyatt with an offer to join Team Psykick, and Wyatt jumps at the chance.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Dunga and Wyatt battle, Wyatt realizes he doesn't possess the skill necessary to control his Cyber Bit Beast. This frustrates Gideon, so he commands Doctor B to seek out a suitable candidate for the job. Meanwhile, Tyson is back home practicing his blading and quickly tires of it. The rest of the BladeBreakers, including Hilary, keep harping on him to continue until he gets it right. But Tyson has had enough and quits! It seems the BladeBreakers are finished! Then, Hilary comes up with an idea! She tells the guys to take a day off and invites them to an afternoon barbecue with Grandpa playing the part of the Chef. At first Tyson wants nothing to do with it, but finally he relents and joins in. After lunch, the kids relax by the river while Grandpa fishes. Suddenly he hooks a big one and gets dragged in the water! The kids run to the rescue, however, a group of four new teenagers appear out of nowhere and rescue Gramps. After a brief conversation, our heroes realize these new kids are also Bladers, so Tyson challenges their leader, Kane, to a battle. After a fierce fight, it ends in a tie and the new kids leave. Tyson thinks he made a new friend, but as it turns out, Kane is the leader of the Psykick's and is in cahoots with the evil Gideon!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kane, Goki, Jim, and Salima arrive at Doctor B's lab to begin battle tests for Gideon. Jim goes first after being given his new Beyblade, Cyber Draciel. He battles against a lopsided number of automated Beyblades, including one behemoth the size of a football. But with Cyber Draciel in tow, victory is decisive. It's obvious however, that the Cyber Bit-Beast's power is having a corrupting influence on Jim. At Mr. Dickenson's office, the BladeBreakers are blackmailed into a future battle against the Psykick's when Doctor B threatens an all-out assault on the city by the Cyber Bit-Beasts. When Tyson hears that his new friend Kane has joined the Psykick's, he refuses to believe it without concrete proof.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After seeing the power of the Cyber Bit Beasts in Team Psykick's Beyblades, Tyson vows to do whatever it takes to beat them. Even if that means breaking the rules and modifying his own Beyblade. Ray protests and demands that the BladeBreakers play fair even if the odds are against them. In a quiet moment down by the river he runs into Salima of Team Psykick and discovers she feels the same way as he does. Salima tries to convince Ray to get the BladeBreakers to forfeit their upcoming match and even offers to reveal the secrets of the Cyber Bit Beasts.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is so determined to beat the Psykick's in an upcoming battle that he's ordered Kenny to modify his Dragoon beyond legal specifications. But because his blade now has too much offensive power, Tyson is unable to control it and he becomes totally frustrated with himself and his blade. The more he tries controlling it, the worse he becomes. His friends try to tell him 'cheating' isn't the way to win, yet Tyson ignores them and being pigheaded as he is, he goes off to sulk about his dilemma.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: The Crimson Queen of the Ishiyama TKKH, who holds the deep confidence of all the women, has returned from subjugating all the Ladies of North Kanto! Hearing the rumors, Furuichi drags Oga along in trying to get a glimpse of her. Before long the Queen appears! She tries to bring the iron hammer down on Oga, who in her absence has defeated two members of Ichiyama's TKKH, and even destroyed half the school, but when she sees Oga appear in front of her...!?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Hilda hears about Kunieda Aoi from Oga and wants to find out more. She goes in search of her to test her skills. At the same time, there's someone with a half-baked scheme against Oga using Aoi's protective attitude.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin manages to steal crime boss Mulligan's precious jewels, only have them stolen from him by Fujiko! Mulligan, unaware that Fujiko has his jewels, hires a skilled gunman named Hangman to take them back from Lupin. Showered with Hangman's bullets, Lupin and his gang return fire with rare wine. Meanwhile, Inspector Zenigata is closing in on Lupin. Will Lupin be able to outrun both Hangman and Inspector Zenigata?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin has been put on auction at the Wanted Club and Dr. Mad places the winning bid. Dr. Mad also purchases Fujiko and Jigen from the Wanted Club's auctions. The three are abandoned on a deserted island with killer cyborgs as part of Dr. Mad's human reconstruction experiment. Can Lupin, Jigen and Fujiko get off the island alive?

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: With a Philosopher's Stone in his possession, Alphonse fearlessly engages Pride and Kimblee. Elsewhere, the Armstrongs find themselves trapped between Sloth's onslaught and the guns of Central's troops.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: After a startling radio broadcast grants Mustang's forces the advantage over Central's troops, the Flame Alchemist unleashes the brutal power of burning hatred in the battle against the killer of Maes Hughes.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: As Envy writhes within the firestorm unleashed by Mustang's vengeful rage, Hawkeye must take drastic measures to prevent the Flame Alchemist's hatred from burning out of control.

programme.title: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom [English Dub]
programme.desc: Naruto, Sakura, and Kakashi team up with Rock Lee to escort Prince Michiru and his son Hikaru, but a villainous uprising awaits their homecoming.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Shadow breaches Blue Typhoon, appearing in Cosmo's room. As he knocks Sonic and Chris unconscious, Shadow goes after Cosmo whom Tails has taken away to safety.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: Blue Typhoon is mysteriously transported to an abandoned planet as Cosmo discovers that Metarex are monitoring what she sees and hears through a chip that is implanted in her. As Tails and Chris try to find a way to remove Cosmo's chip, Amy and Rouge discover that the planet is Cosmo and Metarex's home planet.

programme.title: Sonic X
programme.desc: When everyone is informed by Dr. Eggman of Metarex' gathering in accordance to a thousand-year prophecy Sonic and his crew head off for their final battle, leaving Shadow behind. However Shadow soon follows suit as Chaotix drop by to offer him a ride.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As Shion believed he was innocent, Shishigami confesses to her that his body is a robot and has taken many lives in order to feel alive again. He coldly informs her that he will kill everyone in the country. However, Shion begs Shishigami not to leave her behind. Shion cries as she tells Shishigami that the people he's killed had futures and loved ones, and Shishigami makes a proposition.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A special forces team bursts in to apprehend Shishigami. Shion and her grandmother are shot in the crossfire, and Shishigami manages to grab them before escaping. After taking them to safety, he wishes Shion a happy life. One day, Mari sees her father and Ando together. She follows after and sees Inuyashiki fly off into the sky. That night, Shishigami attacks a police station in vengeance.

programme.title: INUYASHIKI LAST HERO [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: As the news reports on Shishigami's attack on the police station, Shishigami hijacks a broadcast signal to publicly declare war on Japan, claiming he will kill 100 people immediately. Ando realizes Shishigami's plans and manages to thwart it with the help of Inuyashiki's power. Undeterred, Shishigami continues his killing, and announces he will kill 1000 tomorrow, devastating Inuyashiki.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]
programme.desc: Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.

programme.title: Terror in Resonance [English Dub]

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: When Inspector Nakamori catches a glimpse of Kaito's face during an attempted robbery, the young magician has to "prove" he's not Kid the Phantom Thief by going on a date with Aoko at the same time Kid is supposed to make his next appearance!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Real magic comes back to haunt Kaito in the form of Akako. This time, the sorceress is so annoyed with her classmate that she plots to wipe him out when he's in his Phantom Thief identity. And to stack the deck, Akako turns Inspector Nakamori into a murderous thug!

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: In the present, Kaito and Aoko are lured into a trap at the top of the Toto Tower, while in the past, the first Kid the Phantom Thief and the mysterious Phantom Lady have an exciting first encounter at the top of the Eiffel Tower!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: A cat follows Oga home one day. Baby Beel challenges the cat for Oga's attention. Once the showdown is over, they are surrounded by stray cats, and Baby Beel stands tall to defend! This is the start of a friendship between 1 baby and 1 kitty.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Himekawa lives by the motto, "there's nothing that money can't control." In order to get revenge on Oga, he uses the power of money to work behind the scenes in plan after plan to defeat him, but Oga keeps getting the upper hand somehow…

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga's family is seriously worried about Baby Beel's night crying, as it's causing everyone in the entire town to lose sleep. They try all kinds of things but nothing works. Oga heads to school, completely exhausted, as do the other students looking for a fight. Everyone ends up asleep, dreaming...

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin has his eyes on the royal family's Imperial State Crown, but thanks to Scotland Yard's Inspector Dover, stealing it won't be easy. After their initial heist fails, Lupin and his gang plan to take the crown on the day of Princess Mary's royal wedding. Will Big Ben chime in Lupin's favour?

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lupin announces he's going to steal the betting takes at the Kentucky Derby, but the heist falls short and fails. However, it's all part of the plan. Lupin's main target is really the Metropolitan Bank's underground vault. Will Lupin get past their tight security measures and pull off the heist?

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: A rebel victory is imminent and hope takes hold among Mustang and Armstrong's troops. Central's forces teeter on the brink of collapse - until their fallen leader returns to take control.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: Central's forces fight with renewed vigor following Bradley's return, and the Fuhrer himself enters the battle. His first opponent is an armored tank. His second foe is even tougher.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood [English Dub]
programme.desc: The battle for a nation's soul descends into chaos. Bradley unleashes death on those who dare engage him. Beneath Central, the one responsible for the Fuhrer's creation unleashes something far, far worse.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: Lorena queda viuda y se casa con Daniel, pero el difunto regresa y ella quiere que viva en la casa. Cambian a dos niñas por error, una muere y la otra sobrevive, las dos familias la reclaman.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Inventa fábrica de sombreros que adornan los miembros sexuales masculinos cuando están erectos y lo demandan. Erick quiere demostrar que los teléfonos celulares destruyen el cerebro humano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alicia exige que su marido deje su práctica de masajes con nalgadas o se divorcia. Jessica demanda a su amiga Karla, porque le entregó a la policía un teléfono celular que la llevó a la cárcel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Después de años preso, este padre sale de la cárcel y exige la custodia de su hija. Lola quiere emanciparse, su padrastro practica la autoestrangulación en el sexo y así murió su madre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Francisco es repostero y prepara impactantes pasteles con imágenes eróticas y sexuales. A Mariana la echan de su casa por malcriada, ella demanda a sus padres, exige que ellos la mantengan.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Boris es tuerto y su único ojo es para Ana, ella lo amaba, pero él se volvió violento. Raúl pide la custodia de su hija con Isabel, quien quiere curar el autismo de la niña con enemas de cloro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Elizabeth exige un cambio en la póliza de su complejo residencial que respete el nudismo-cristianismo. Blanca pide una orden de desalojo y una de alejamiento para Pablo, pero él no piensa marcharse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maritza adopta a Santiago, cuando crece se enamora de él y sale embarazada. Williams quiere impedir que su esposa mexicana entre a la academia de policía. El momento es muy conflictivo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Bárbara demanda a Estefany, porque se llevó de la casa el juguete sexual que compartían. Sebastián pide el divorcio, cree que su esposa lo engañó, tuvo gemelas, una es negra y la otra blanca.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Hugo quiere las cenizas de su bebé para llevarlas a Cuba, es Babalawo y necesita recuperar su energía. David debe ir a la cárcel, pero antes, quiere darle a su cuñada la custodia de su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos hombres y una mujer tienen una relación y ella se embaraza, quieren saber quién tiene derechos sobre el bebé. Flor desea dar a luz de manera natural en el Amazonas, su esposo está aterrado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roberto exige que Carolina cumpla el contrato que firmaron, ella quiere anularlo porque él está obsesionado. Expulsan a Manolo de la escuela por hacer una película porno, su madre lo defiende.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Loraine es una niña de 15 años y tiene un novio de 40; quiere emanciparse de su madre. Diego pide ayuda psicológica para su esposa; ella solo tiene sexo si ve las películas porno de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una madre descubre que en el jardín de infantes amarran a su hija de cuatro años, por lo que demanda a la dueña. Laura denuncia que la despidieron por negarse a participar en el desafío de las cubetas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlitos le teme tanto a los gérmenes y bacterias que no hace el amor con su esposa, ella intenta una locura. Bruno exige una orden de alejamiento para su exmujer, ella lo persigue y lo acosa.

programme.title: Prepper
programme.desc: A high school teacher is living the typical suburban life until realizing that it wouldn't take much for society to collapse. Enlisting the help of his wife, he embarks on a quest to be ready for anything without spending all his money, losing the respect of his friends, or becoming a survivalist freak.

programme.title: Snowflake
programme.desc: Hunting down the murderer of their families in an anarchic Berlin of the near future, the outlaws Tan and Javid find themselves trapped in the wicked fairytale of a mysterious screenplay that entangles them in a vicious circle of revenge - apparently all written by a clueless dentist. **Subtitled**

programme.title: Sons of Liberty
programme.desc: An elite team of scientists and soldiers unite to thwart a terrorist plot to detonate a nuclear weapon along the Gulf Coast.

programme.title: Savage Island
programme.desc: Julia Young and Steven Harris are having marital troubles, but on a weekend trip to visit Julia's family on the remote Savage Island, marital problems quickly become the least of their worries.

programme.title: Soren
programme.desc: Exploration of love and relationships in contemporary Bolivia.

programme.title: Tail Sting
programme.desc: A pack of massive genetically altered Scorpions escape containment on an airplane, turning passengers into victims and forcing one ordinary woman to confront her worst fears.

programme.title: Slaughter is the Best Medicine
programme.desc: A handpicked team of British commandoes take on a simple mission: Extract the mysterious Professor Black from his hiding place in Gallows Woods and bring him back alive.

programme.title: Revenge Of The Samurai Cop
programme.desc: A cop comes out of hiding to avenge the death of his wife and must take on a banished warlord who may be his wife's killer. With Tommy Wiseau (The Room)

programme.title: Smokers
programme.desc: A group of troubled teenage girls enact revenge on the boys who mistreated them in this biting dark comedy. The stunning clique of girls couple their togetherness with smoking only to be taunted by those more popular than them.

programme.title: Rum Runners
programme.desc: Rum Runners is the epic story of two best friends, Vic Hanson and Don Calyer. They get caught running illegal booze across the Canadian border. Inspired by actual events.

programme.title: Secrets In The Fall
programme.desc: Nothing is impossible for a group of young campers, friends and enemies alike, on a weekend retreat at Camp Pinnacle. But what starts as an exciting wilderness adventure turns into trouble when a young camper goes missing and the rest of the group must set out to find him.

programme.title: CERN & The Sense of Beauty
programme.desc: An exploration of the link between science and beauty through the work of scientists at CERN, in Geneva.

programme.title: Bunny The Killer Thing
programme.desc: A group of Finnish and British people get stuck at a cabin when they are attacked by a creature that is a half human, half rabbit.

programme.title: Charlotte
programme.desc: A teenage girl is baby sitting at a new house when she's accosted by a vicious, possessed doll. With the baby sitter in bondage, the toy subjects her to a series of terrifying tales on the television, each story more twisted than the last.

programme.title: Border Blues
programme.desc: A dangerous smuggler helps an attractive woman and her 5-year-old daughter, while a police chief pursues a mad bomber in Los Angeles. Starring Eric Roberts, Gary Busey, Rodion Nahapetov

programme.title: Butterfly
programme.desc: NICK COLE, a straight-to-video horror director who is kidnapped by, LANEY, an over zealous fan, determined to impress him with her own film project. The situation goes from bad to worse when Cole realizes that the murders in Laney's film are real, and that the victims are all people from his own dark past. Starring Mandi Kreisher, Jay Laisne, Sky Kelley

programme.title: Cannibal
programme.desc: Max is agoraphobic and lives in a cabin in the middle of nowhere. One night, he finds a beautiful unconscious woman (Bianca). Her body is covered with blood.

programme.title: Blue Family
programme.desc: Based on true events, Blue Family follows the charming used car salesman Armando as he works on creating a perfect family. For underneath his sunny disposition, lies a dark secret. In an attempt to make up for a childhood of abuse and the family he never had, he hand picks his own family by kidnaping three attractive young women.

programme.desc: Hay coraje y mal genio cuando dos prisioneros comparten una celda. Una mujer ebria les hace pasar un mal rato a los oficiales. Un estafador detenido por manejar tomado quiere cambiar y mejorar.

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre admite haber orinado en público. Una cita amorosa termina en cita en la cárcel. Se sospecha que un hombre maneja tomado y se desmaya durante el ingreso a la cárcel.

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se descubre un alijo secreto cuando se revisa la propiedad de un sospechoso. Dos prisioneros escándalos terminan no llevándose bien por no respetarse el uno al otro. Se le siguen cayendo los pantalones a un peatón cruzando a media calle.

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero se vuelve agresivo cuando lo revisan durante una inspección común in corriente. Un anciano confundido piensa que el centro de detención es el sitio de un concurso de poesía. Dos novias se pelean mientras apuestan.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: La novia mal entraña de un narcotraficante termina aislada. La policía atiende a un problema con un hombre ebrio acusado de tirar piedras. Los guardias tratan de calmar un pleito entre compañeros de celda.

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero interrumpe el proceso de ingreso a la cárcel. La violencia domestica entre una pareja es evidente, pero ellos la niegan y dicen que en realidad era intimidad. Una mujer encarcelada con cámara escondida comparte los videos intrusivos.

Un turista encarcelado amenaza con traer a Johnny Cochran como abogado para su defensa. Un conductor ebrio se despierta y encuentra una obra de arte pornográfica dibujada en su cuerpo.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and "Captain" Nick explore this beautiful riverboat town. First stop, the iconic Lafayette Hotel. Next, they see firsthand how to make history on a stick then indulge in some local craft brews. Also, a special encounter with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Sarah Graham meets with the head chef of the restaurant at Victoria Falls Safari Lodge and learns the recipe for their famous warthog steaks; Sarah prepares a brie baked in phyllo pastry and pear tarte tatin with white chocolate and rosemary drizzle.

programme.title: Wine, Dine and Stein
programme.desc: Chef Jack Stein travels with his family to find the ultimate pairings with wine and food.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit Old Town Sacramento, located near their home town of Auburn.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave and Kari take a cruise to New Zealand, Tasmania, and Australia.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Mauritians have a passion for tea. Their esteem and adoration almost match that of the British. Vanilla tea in particular, is a staple in Mauritian house-holds. Brent begins his journey into the history of this grand love affair at Bois Cheri Tea Factory, home to some of the oldest tea fields on the island. After learning how tea goes from a leafy bush to a brew-able bag he gets to experience the various flavours at a tea tasting with a view. Brent then meets up with a Mauritian local, Aurelie, at Flaq market to buy ingredients for a tea dish she is going to teach him. It's a beautiful day and, regardless of his fear of heights, Brent decides to fit in some parasailing before the cook. He then heads to Cap Malheureux where he and Aurelie cook her mother's tea chicken dish.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Host Chef Phillip Davenport asks why so very few people outside of Malaysia ever discuss, let alone praise its fine dining venues so we begin by providing the evidence that the Capital city Kuala Lumpur has the fine dining credentials and an ever growing list of culinary geniuses.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil delves into the KL city's suburban and modern mall food culture. His theory is that a measure of a cities culinary excellence is how good the suburban restaurants are.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Amid the leafy enclosure of KL suburbia lies a piece of exotic Ceylon, namely Aliyaa Restaurant and Bar and its where Chef Phil discovers exec Chef Pradeep specialising in his signature dry cooked curries.This is what fine dining Sri Lankan cuisine is all about.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Isadora Chai is a chef who was a scientist so experimentation is what she thrives on and when she opens her mouth this chef can swear like Gordon Ramsay and invariably does. A fun episode

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: A beautiful tropical island, two world class restaurants and two great Chefs ,Chef Phil and his old friend Chef Richard. They take us on a culinary tour de force presenting some intriguing western recipes and a range delicious modern Langkawi/Malaysia fare.This is a recipe intense episode with plenty to see and learn.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil arrives at the Imperial Sheraton, home of the Celestial Court and his base while he uncovers the enormous culinary exercise that takes place every day here. We begin the Celestial Court where the decisions on what to cook are tough but we end up with classic crispy skinned Roast Duck, Di Sum and a Wok fried Chilli Tempe thats a world beater.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This place rocks and it does in a very Argentinian way.The best meat cooked to perfection is what we see and learn how to achieve. At Pampas meat is what they are all about and Chef Phil discovers thats why the place is packed out every night.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is an episode dedicated to decadence. Sit back, relax and salivate. Chef Phil and Chef Gaeton take us through the intracacies of making a modern boulliabase from scratch. It is an art. As well we will learn what herbs and spices it takes to lift any gin to levels heavenly.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: We are nearly 60 stories up looking over super KL modern city with the twin towers in our face. This is Italian high end cuisine cooked by owner/chef Modesto Marini himself. We see him with Chef Phil in the working kitchen cooking some Marini signatures and later at the bar delving into some mysterious cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This Venue is quite simply downright impressive and the big question to come was will the kitchen produce a match for where it will be presented. We see Chef Phil work his way through the decadent degustation then migrate to the kitchen to learn about the preparation.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Another extraordinarily extravagant venue in the centre of the KL Culinary universe. Marble 8 is like a club for the rich and famous in New York or Hollywood and from from what Chef eats, drinks and cooks it could as well be.This is a lavish treat from the walk through the steak aging vault to the flaming crepe suzette prepared at the table.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Yet another culinary gem in the suburbs of KL.This is real Italian with an intense Abruzzian Italian at the helm. Chef Stefano is young and like most great Italian chefs Stefano’s inspiration came from his mothers cooking.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa. A Gabriel le ofrecen ir a hacer un discurso a Caja Seca, un pueblo cercano, para, entre otras cosas, desviar la atención de los medios por el problema con Magdalena. Gabriel acepta, y Gloria lo acompaña.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo se entera de la verdad y Elizabeth le pide no casarse con Katiuska. Alejandro declara su amor a Manuela. Los médicos informan que a Celia le queda poco tiempo de vida; Katiuska envía a Carrero para eliminarla, pero él huye al ser descubierto. Vincenzo y Tirsa revelan la existencia de un testamento actualizado en Italia. Ricardo, harto de las presiones de Katiuska y su familia por la boda, rompe la lista de invitados y abandona la casa para apoyar a Manuela y Celia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior, ignorando que Rosa es su hermana, le jura amor eterno y le pide casarse cuanto antes. Rosa siente la angustia de no poder decirle la verdad. Erasto queda postrado por parálisis total y Arminda lo cuida con satíricos remedios. Eustoquio celebra el castigo divino y proyecta apoderarse de la fortuna. Adolfo decide contarle a Junior la verdad sobre Rosa pero teme su reacción por su delicado estado. Consuelo ruega a Blanca por consejos. Rosa busca refugio en Isaías. Carmen Rosa fallece en su cama dejando a Rosa huérfana de su único amor materno verdadero.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Agustina asesina a su hermana Rebeca para salvar a Irene y a su bebé. Luego los doctores revelan que ella sufría un trastorno de doble personalidad y que creía fervientemente que ella era en realidad su hermana muerta. Tony y Maribel terminan juntos, por comprar una nueva casa para irse a vivir juntos y formar una nueva familia. También Anzola termina casándose con Trinidad en una fiesta de casamiento a la cual toda la familia estuvo invitada. Felipe logra poner tras las rejas a Alejandra y a Rodrigo por los crímenes que cometieron. programme.title: Para Verte Mejor

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Giovanni Talamonti tiene dos hijos Augusto con su esposa y con su amante Luis Francisco y al morir les deja fortuna a cada uno en distintos lugares a Luis Francisco en Italia. Augusto no sabe de la existencia de su medio hermano. Luis Francisco conoce a Clemencia que vivía en un tráiler y hacía poco acababa de morir su padre. Se enamoran y Clemencia queda embarazada pero Luis Francisco lo desconoce y va a Italia en busca de la fortuna que heredó.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Pedro tiene montado en una de las habitaciones de su apartamento un sistema de espionaje a los vecinos del condominio. Con cámaras instaladas dentro de las viviendas, va manejando y observando las conversaciones y los detalles de la vida de cada uno de los habitantes del complejo. Es así que se entera de todos los pormenores, y entre ellos descubre a Cristóbal en una conversación consigo mismo en donde deja a la luz su sospecha de infidelidad entre Ana y su primo Guillermo.

programme.title: Episodio 109
programme.desc: Yubiri está super feliz en su casa repartiendo regalos a su familia y todos están que brincan de la felicidad. Lolita le dice a Wilker que la gorrita se la regaló Yubiri. Llega Solymar y comienzan a hablar sobre lo de la presentación. ROKUro y Segundo conversan de los regalos hechos por Yubiri para estrenarlos con sus respectivas conquistas. En casa de Briggite están hablando ella Carolina y Dionisia de quienes se están por casar. Llega Junior para informarles que al otro día se casa.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel debe alejarse de la ciudad para llegar a un pueblo llamado Caja Seca por razones de trabajo. Lo que nunca se imagina es que Magdalena se encuentre en ese pueblo también por asuntos laborales, y el destino hace que se junten. Gloria decide contarle a Gabriel que ella ya está al tanto de la enfermedad que tiene él en los riñones. Su intención es ayudarlo en lo que necesite y que pueda confiar en ella. Sin embargo, él siente que la gente le puede llegar a tener lástima y, por eso, quiere callar. Angie y Agustín están desesperados por comunicarse con sus respectivas parejas. Ellos llaman a Gabriel y a Magdalena pero no obtienen ninguna respuesta.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo deja a Katiuska y se va de su casa. Celia regresa a su hogar en estado grave, mientras Manuela busca a su hermana Cecilia para que se reconcilien. Vincenzo y Tirsa informan sobre el testamento de la Nona. Katiuska manipula a Glorita para que odie a Ricardo y enfrenta una orden de ADN de Misael. Marcelo se indigna por la confesión de María del Pilar sobre Gustavo. Ricardo considera casarse con Manuela para darle una última alegría a Celia, quien elige a Juan Marcos como padrino.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa llora la muerte de Carmen Rosa, la única madre que conoció, sintiéndose huérfana de afecto. Consuelo intenta acercarse al funeral pero Rosa se niega a recibirla. Isaías se mantiene firme apoyando a Rosa. Junior empeora preguntando por Rosa. Adolfo se prepara para confesarle el parentesco. Erasto continúa postrado mientras Arminda y Eustoquio planean su muerte y la apropiación de su fortuna. Vilma es interrogada por la policía sobre el intento de asesinato a Leticia. Rosalía continúa con su odio a Rosa y le exige a Alejandro pruebas formales del parentesco.

Clemencia se queda a solas con Luis Francisco y lo trata con indiferencia. Luis Francisco le confiesa que Augusto es su hermano y Clemencia supone acertadamente que éste está en busca de dinero. Entonces Clemencia le da la dirección de un restaurante y queda en encontrarse con él allí para hablar.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El corrupto alcalde se niega a ayudar tras el intento de violación, pues el agresor es cercano a Ortega. La familia Guerrero intenta huir, pero el banco lo impide. Esa noche, en las fiestas, Alejandro propone repartir ganancias, idea que enfurece a Ortega. Horas después, el Esmeraldero le muestra al supuesto violador para que lo asesine, desatando tensión y dilemas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: La familia Guerrero busca adaptarse con trabajos, mientras Alejandro se involucra en el registro de esmeraldas para frenar la corrupción, lo que irrita a Ortega. Eduardo quiere dinero en las minas, pero su padre lo frena por temor a su ambición. Reina intenta negociar con su primo para entrar al negocio, pero él se niega a ayudarla.

programme.title: Familiarizado
programme.desc: Dos viejos conocidos del colegio se reencuentran en un bar y sienten una atracción instantánea. Aunque ambos tienen pareja, sus encuentros secretos se vuelven cada vez más románticos mientras deciden qué quieren realmente en el amor y en la vida.

programme.title: Mi Billonario Secreto
programme.desc: Para satisfacer el deseo de su padre, un apuesto y poderoso multimillonario viaja solo, sin dinero y sin usar su nombre real a la ciudad de Nueva York. Cuando el ex playboy conoce a un agente inmobiliario atractivo y con los pies en la tierra, la razón detrás del deseo de su padre se vuelve evidente y ambos descubrirán que el amor verdadero es algo que el dinero no puede comprar.

programme.title: Familiarizado

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: El Coronel Sahota lucha por conseguir mejoras para la NSG. Mientras tanto, la vida en Mumbai continúa con normalidad, sin saber de la amenaza inminente. Parvati, una joven periodista, enfrenta obstáculos para que su reportaje sea aprobado por el canal de noticias.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Una familia de agricultores necesita ayuda para evitar que su granja se convierta en desierto. El equipo muestra a la familia la importancia de no talar árboles y luego despega para luchar contra una tormenta de polvo que se aproxima. Con la ayuda de un nuevo invento de la Dra. Serene, logran evitar que el desierto siga avanzando.

programme.title: Contención
programme.desc: Los vecinos de un complejo de apartamentos se despiertan una mañana y descubren que extraños con trajes protectores los han encerrado dentro. Incapaces de identificar a los infectados de los sanos, los en cuarentena comienzan a cuestionar a las autoridades y a enfrentarse entre sí en una lucha por la supervivencia cargada de adrenalina.

programme.title: Impacto Solar
programme.desc: Cuando los desechos solares caen contra la Tierra provocando una devastación generalizada, la radiación solar resultante provoca mutaciones genéticas en todos los que entran en contacto. A medida que la radiactividad se propaga rápidamente, y con los gobiernos y militares de todo el mundo al borde del colapso, un grupo de amigos se une para huir del caos, desesperados y con la esperanza de encontrar refugio.

A partir de entonces, comienzan a ocurrir sucesos extraños en el observatorio, lo que lo lleva a una búsqueda desesperada por descubrir la verdadera naturaleza de su hallazgo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim y Rivero atacan al Chema, mientras Marcado y Medardo asaltan el búnker para matar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas mata a Medardo, y Marcado huye para ayudar al Chema luego de que Tim y Rivero incautan el uranio. Tijeras también escapa, mientras Mónica acepta la condición de Omar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor golpea a Casillas, lo deja herido y amenaza con matarlo: ahora sabe que sexo y muerte van de la mano. Mónica y Rutila ya tienen su propio negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas busca a Mónica, pero ella lo rechaza y le dice que se aleje de su hijo, mientras el Chema amenaza a Rutila. Tijeras convence a Marcado y se escapan a Colombia en un avión del Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas sorprende a su familia, pero Irma lo acusa de haber entregado a Chacorta a cambio de su libertad. Rutila recibe la carta de Ernesto, mientras el Chema le exige que seduzca a Rivero.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim le pide a Casillas que le envíe un cargamento de droga a Chicago, pero él no tiene ni mercancía ni dinero para volver a montar su red de narcotráfico. Leonor ve de nuevo a Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas jura ante la tumba de Chacorta que vengará su muerte, y acusa a Irma de ser la culpable por convencerlo de dejar el negocio. Prepara una coartada para llevar a cabo su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio mata a Irma, y hace ver que murió en el ataque de la Policía y la Marina al rancho de Sinaloa. Logran escapar del tiroteo, pero Chabela queda malherida. Feyo promete enviar la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor llora la muerte de Chabela y de sus hijos, mientras Casillas le plantea la venganza. Tim trata de convencer a Rivero de que Aurelio no estaba en Sinaloa. Leonor busca olvidar a Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor le dice a Aurelio que acepta entrar en el negocio para vengar la muerte de Chabela y sus hijos, y le entrega el dinero de la venta del ganado. Mónica le exige al Chema que se aleje.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta seducir a la Condesa, quien le coquetea, pero asegura que es fiel a Feyo. Víctor quiere comenzar su venganza y matar al que dio el pitazo de que estaba en el rancho de Sinaloa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Víctor viaja con Aurelio a Chicago para entregar la droga a Tim, y crecen sus sospechas sobre el Espanto. Rutila visita a Ernesto y le miente, mientras doña Alba la compara con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema secuestra a su propio hijo para demostrarle a Rutila que él pone las reglas, mientras su rabia aumenta luego de que el Güero le dice que le hizo una visita conyugal a Ernesto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema sigue castigando a Rutila: le dice que tiene que ganarse a su hijo o la madre sustituta lo hará. Garnica recibe el dinero para matar a Ernesto, ahora con el apoyo de Venegas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le propone a Feyo una alianza: comprar su finca, pero que, a cambio, lo ayude a matar al Chema. Leonor acusa a Rawlins de utilizar a Aurelio para inundar a Chicago de drogas y llevarse los elogios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aunque Tim le cambió la pauta, Casillas ordena lanzar granadas a la casa del Chema, pero se entera de que ahí está el hijo de Rutila. Omar está con Mónica y recibe la visita inesperada de Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila se muda con el Chema para estar con su hijo, luego que Aurelio le echa en cara que quedó embarazada para vengarse. Tim le propone a Rivero dar un golpe con la captura de Víctor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica cae de nuevo en los brazos de Aurelio, quien le confiesa que planeó el ataque al rancho para salir de Irma, pero también murió Chabela. Marcado y Garnica le tienden una trampa al Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa del ataque de Marcado. Rutila no se salva y paga las consecuencias. A Marcado no le importa nada, y mata a su propia familia frente a los ojos de la hija de Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Destrozada, Rutila le cuenta al Chema que Marcado la violó y le echa la culpa. Llama a Aurelio para que la ayude a vengarse, pero Venegas le dice que si habla, no volverá a ver a su hijo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con el Chema y le exige que le devuelva a su nieto, mientras Rutila se desahoga con Víctor y le advierte que ahora los dos enfrentan el odio muy de cerca.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tim amenaza a Aurelio con detener a su familia, pero los planes de Morejón lo llevan a pactar con él la muerte de su jefe, Jack Meléndez. Rivero desconfía de Rawlings y aún no sabe la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Adriana “Ady” Jiménez, clavadista mexicana y campeona mundial de clavados de altura, quien nos comparte cómo el deporte marcó cada etapa de su vida. Desde sus inicios en el karate hasta su ingreso al Comité Olímpico Mexicano a los 13 años, Ady Jiménez recuerda la disciplina, los sacrificios y los sueños que la formaron como atleta. Entre anécdotas de infancia, frustraciones como perder un pase olímpico en 2004 y el retiro temporal que la alejó de la plataforma durante una década, la clavadista narra su sorprendente regreso: decretar antes de saltar, vencer el miedo y abrazar la adrenalina de los 20 metros de altura. Hoy, retirada oficialmente desde 2022, Ady busca dejar un legado a través de la nueva federación de clavados, convencida de que el miedo no es un obstáculo, sino un motor. Su historia es un viaje de resiliencia, pasión y amor absoluto por el deporte.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con El Coreanito Mateos, ex-boxeador y ahora entrenador, quien comparte su inspiradora trayectoria desde una infancia difícil hasta convertirse en uno de los referentes del boxeo mexicano. Desde su primer encuentro con un gimnasio a los 13 años hasta ganar el prestigioso torneo Guantes de Oro en 1994, Mateos nos relata cómo la disciplina, la pasión y el sacrificio definieron su carrera. El Coreanito nos lleva al corazón del ring: sus mejores peleas, los retos de mantenerse en forma, las derrotas y victorias que marcaron su vida.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Charlamos con Steffy Aradillas, figura del softbol mexicano e integrante del equipo nacional que hizo historia en los Juegos Olímpicos de Tokio 2021. A través de una conversación cercana, Steffy comparte su camino desde la infancia en la Liga Maya hasta convertirse en medallista internacional, profesional con estudios de maestría y una de las voces más inspiradoras del deporte femenino en México.Con anécdotas que van desde su vida en Estados Unidos hasta su participación con los Diablos Rojos, Steffy habla de disciplina, identidad, conexión emocional con el público y el impacto de las mujeres en el diamante. Este episodio nos presenta a una atleta íntegra, auténtica y carismática, que ha hecho del deporte no solo una carrera, sino un canal para transformar realidades y representar con orgullo a su país dentro y fuera del campo.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con Marco Navarro, ciclista de alto rendimiento y actual entrenador, quien abre su historia personal y profesional con honestidad, entrega y pasión. Desde sus primeras vueltas en bicicleta por el Bosque de Aragón en la Ciudad de México, hasta representar a México a nivel internacional, Marco comparte los desafíos de un camino marcado por la constancia, las carencias y el amor al deporte. Navarro relata cómo se forjó entre campeones, sin bicicleta propia y enfrentando lesiones, como la que lo dejó dos meses sin caminar después de una medalla. Reflexiona sobre el impacto del alto rendimiento, la rivalidad en la selección nacional, y su evolución como coach, guiando a nuevas generaciones. El episodio profundiza en lo que implica mantenerse en la cima y el valor de reinventarse, descubrimos a un hombre que transformó las caídas en impulso, y que hoy busca sembrar en otros la misma determinación que lo llevó a la élite.

programme.title: Django (1966)
programme.desc: En un pueblo fantasma, Django arrastra un ataúd misterioso y salva a una mujer. Pronto se ve atrapado entre un mayor racista y un general revolucionario. Las balas vuelan y todos quieren saber qué esconde el ataúd.

programme.title: Martín Fierro
programme.desc: La historia del gaucho rebelde Martín Fierro y su gente cobra vida en la inmensidad de la Pampa argentina. Entre libertad, desafíos y una vida marcada por las duras condiciones de su época, descubre un mundo donde cada decisión tiene consecuencias.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: De niño, Johnny vio morir a su padre a manos de soldados. Ahora, convertido en forajido, mata a soldados siempre que puede. El teniente Garringo recibe la misión de arrestarlo y llevarlo de regreso con vida. La caza se convierte en un juego peligroso entre el destino y la venganza.

programme.title: Cassidy Red
programme.desc: Cassidy regresa a su pueblo natal del Viejo Oeste buscando vengar a su amante asesinado por su exprometido, un agente de la ley corrupto. Dividida entre amor, odio y justicia, su búsqueda se convierte en una batalla feroz por redención y verdad.

programme.title: Venganza sangrienta
programme.desc: Los padres de Tom son asesinados por forajidos mexicanos después de que su líder (Van Cleef) violara a su madre mientras miraba.

programme.title: Los rastreadores
programme.desc: Cuando la hija de un ranchero es secuestrada por los apaches, forma un grupo y envía a buscar al mariscal de EE.UU., pero en su lugar aparece un mariscal adjunto afroamericano.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 46, 47
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Persecución mortal
programme.desc: El pistolero Silver es contratado por un abogado para demostrar que su cliente, Chester Conway, es inocente del atraco a la taberna por el que ha sido condenado a la horca.

programme.title: Los rurales de Texas (Texas Ranger)
programme.desc: El sargento de policía Robert Logan recibe la misión de capturar a Cassidy, un fugitivo acusado de asesinato que asegura ser inocente. Antiguos amigos, ambos emprenden una peligrosa huida mientras intentan descubrir la verdad y enfrentarse a los desafíos que encuentran en el camino.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros rápidos (Four Fast Guns)
programme.desc: Un pistolero llega a la ciudad de Purgatory afirmando ser el “pacificador” esperado, aunque oculta haber causado la muerte del hombre cuya misión ahora asume. A cambio de una recompensa, decide enfrentarse al jefe criminal local, un líder en silla de ruedas que envía a varios asesinos para eliminarlo.

programme.title: No Me Entierren
programme.desc: Dos mujeres ocultan la sorprendente verdad mientras un sheriff investiga un asesinato.

programme.title: Un dólar agujereado
programme.desc: Un dólar agujereado - Después de la Guerra Civil, el ex oficial regresa a casa donde se ve envuelto en las disputas locales que involucran a un hombre fuerte sin escrúpulos y a sus secuaces contratados.

programme.title: La muerte pasa lista
programme.desc: Héroe enmascarado con látigo de toro. Película número 2 de 4.

programme.title: La marca del gavilán
programme.desc: Un misterioso héroe enmascarado recorre los caminos a caballo, enfrentándose al crimen y protegiendo a quienes lo necesitan. En esta nueva aventura de «El Látigo Negro», deberá demostrar su valor mientras una amenaza pone a prueba su habilidad para hacer justicia.

programme.title: Vende la pistola y cómprate la tumba
programme.desc: Vende la pistola y cómprate la tumba - Sartana, cazarrecompensas y pistolero, es testigo del robo de un cargamento de oro.

programme.title: Ben y Charlie
programme.desc: Cuando, tras cumplir una condena de tres años, Ben Bellow sale de prisión, Charlie Logan lo está esperando para dejar claro que no quiere volver a saber nada de él. Sin embargo, el destino los obliga a reencontrarse una y otra vez: terminan robando un banco juntos y viviendo innumerables aventuras mientras se detestan.

programme.title: Texas El Rojo
programme.desc: La familia Sorenson es masacrada, al parecer por los indios. En el lugar de la matanza crece un pueblo, Gold Hill, dirigido por un grupo de hombres de negocios.

programme.title: La Ley de Dan Candy
programme.desc: Basada en un hecho real, esta es la trágica historia del fugitivo de Saskatchewan Almighty Voice (Gordon Tootoosis), un indio Cree que es arrestado por robar ganado del gobierno por hambre desesperada.

programme.title: Talpa
programme.desc: Cuando su exitoso hermano enferma, un hombre despreocupado debe asumir las responsabilidades del negocio familiar. Lo que comienza como una oportunidad para cambiar su vida toma un rumbo peligroso cuando surge una relación prohibida con su cuñada.

programme.title: El cuatrero errante
programme.desc: El hermano se enfrenta al hermano en esta historia de rancheros enfrentados en el viejo oeste.

programme.title: Juan Moreira
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, el arriero Juan Moreira es un buen gaucho y trabajador que, como muchos otros, es objeto de abusos y humillaciones por parte de los poderosos: los terratenientes de la policía.

programme.title: El forajido
programme.desc: Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday y Billy the Kid se enfrentan entre sí por la ley y las atenciones de la vivaz zorra campesina Río McDonald.

programme.title: Dos vivales en Fuerte Álamo
programme.desc: En plena Guerra Civil Americana, los soldados sicilianos Ciccio y Franco son encarcelados por deserción. Pero su destino da un giro inesperado cuando el ejército los recluta para una arriesgada misión de espionaje, confiando en que su torpeza aparente les permita engañar al enemigo. Una comedia bélica llena de enredos.

programme.title: El gran gato
programme.desc: Durante una sequía en Utah en los años 30, un puma amenaza al ganado y enfrenta a los granjeros. Danny se muda a la granja de su padrastro, atrapado entre tensiones familiares, un amor inesperado y el peligro creciente. Una fallida cacería al felino desata nuevas decisiones difíciles.

programme.title: Cuatro pistoleros de Santa Trinidad
programme.desc: El tráfico de armas con los indios, por un lado, y la adquisición de documentos relativos a la propiedad de una mina de oro, por otro, son los principales intereses de Quin y Gómez, los muy sospechosos huéspedes de la posada de Papá Martínez.

programme.title: Las águilas negras de Santa Fe
programme.desc: Cuando los comanches se ponen en pie de guerra, los colonos se refugian en la Roca del Águila comandada por el Capitán Jackson.

programme.title: La pantera de Monte Escondido
programme.desc: Mongo busca apoderarse del plano de un yacimiento petrolero y elimina a dos de sus compañeros. El hacendado Jacinto posee parte del mapa y encarga a Leonardo recuperar la pieza faltante. Mientras La Pantera protege a Mongo y una peligrosa búsqueda comienza en Monte Escondido, Leonardo y sus amigos se enfrentan a nuevos peligros.

programme.title: La norteña de mis amores
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su padre, un niño crece marcado por el deseo de venganza. Ya adulto, regresa decidido a enfrentarse al responsable, pero en el camino se enamora de una mujer que también ha sufrido por culpa del mismo enemigo. Entre el amor y la venganza, deberá elegir su destino.

programme.title: Joaquín Murrieta
programme.desc: La historia de Joaquín Murrieta, un bandido mexicano que aterrorizó California con su banda de asaltantes y asesinos durante la primera mitad del siglo XIX. Algunos lo veían como un forajido asesino, otros como el Robin Hood mexicano.

programme.title: La ley de la fuerza
programme.desc: Una colonia cuáquera trata de salvar a las gigantescas secuoyas de un barón maderero.

programme.title: El Pequeño Robin Hood
programme.desc: En un pueblo del oeste norteamericano, durante el siglo XIX, un viejo gitano de nombre Aramís, acompañado del pequeño Robin Hood y Lucifer, un chimpancé, se dedica a hacer actos de arquería que impresionan para ganarse la vida. Así, mientras recorren el lugar se van viendo involucrados en distintas situaciones que requieren de su valerosa ayuda y sus asombrosas aptitudes, aunque no siempre sean tratados con justicia.
