programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: «Enséñame a vivir» narra el reinado de terror de un asesino en serie que rompe la paz de una ciudad tranquila. El número de víctimas no deja de crecer, y el miedo se apodera de todos. La policía cree haber atrapado al culpable y lo encierra, dando el caso por cerrado. Pero entonces ocurre un nuevo asesinato. Un psiquiatra se ofrece a ayudar en la investigación y accede a reunirse con el sospechoso... quien le revela una verdad aterradora y mucho más peligrosa de lo que nadie imaginaba.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: La investigación destapa una serie de asesinatos con el mismo patrón, ocurridos hace 25 años. Su autor, Kosarev, cumple cadena perpetua y acaba de ver rechazada su libertad condicional por la comisión de Lavrov. Entre tensiones con Lavrov, Storozheva lo acompaña a visitar al exdetective Puchkov, quien trabajó el caso original... pero se niega a colaborar y actúa con sospecha. Al vigilarlo, descubren su vínculo con Gavrishin, el principal sospechoso de aquellos crímenes.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Puchkov se reúne con Kosarev en prisión. Este último cree que los nuevos asesinatos pueden probar su inocencia. Gavrishin, sintiéndose nuevamente sospechoso, atrae a Lavrov a una imprenta abandonada para contarle su versión de los hechos. Rita y el oficial Tolik llegan al lugar, pero durante la detención, Gavrishin sufre un shock insulínico. Esa misma noche, asesinan a otra mujer, quien resulta ser paciente de Lavrov en la clínica psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Rita visita a Katya, la exesposa de Lavrov, para confirmar su coartada, y sale convencida de su inocencia: informa a su superior, Nikushin, que el verdadero objetivo del asesino podría ser Lavrov, y Katya la próxima víctima. Nikushin toma personalmente su seguridad. Mientras tanto, Rita descubre que Kosarev tuvo un hermano menor muerto en la infancia, y Lavrov empieza a sospechar de uno de sus pacientes, Starostin, quien padece trastorno de identidad disociativo.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov descubre que estaba equivocado sobre Starostin. Nikushin esconde a Katya en un apartamento secreto y entre ellos surge una atracción. Lavrov empieza a sentirse vigilado, instala una cámara oculta en su oficina y, al revisar las grabaciones, reconoce a alguien entrando. Esa noche, aparece inesperadamente en la casa de Rita, causando un gran susto a su madre.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Nikushin consigue permiso para que Rita y Lavrov visiten a Kosarev en prisión. Durante una fiesta en honor al dueño de la clínica psiquiátrica, Lavrov confronta al desconocido que irrumpió en su oficina. Más tarde, él y Rita dejan la ciudad para entrevistarse con Kosarev. Mientras tanto, un desconocido irrumpe en el apartamento donde se esconde Katya.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: A través del análisis psicológico, Lavrov descubre que Kosarev conoce al verdadero asesino, pero se niega a revelar su identidad. Nikushin encuentra a Katya en un hotel. Un compañero de celda de Kosarev le entrega a Rita y Lavrov una carta que Kosarev intentó destruir. Aunque el remitente usa una dirección falsa, la información hace que Lavrov sospeche de Nikushin.

programme.title: Enséñame a vivir
programme.desc: Lavrov intenta advertir a Katya del peligro, pero ella no le cree. Rita, por su parte, duda de la culpabilidad de Nikushin. Mientras Lavrov investiga el pasado de Nikushin, Rita sigue una pista sobre la posible implicación de medicamentos en los asesinatos en serie. Katya le confiesa a Nikushin que en el pasado ya intentaron asesinarla. Esa misma noche, otra mujer es asesinada.

programme.title: Antes que cante el gallo
programme.desc: La adolescente Carmín ve desvanecerse su sueño de mudarse a la ciudad junto a su madre Doris, quien decide partir a Estados Unidos con su nuevo esposo. Ahora, Carmín crece y vive en Barranquitas, un pintoresco pueblo montañoso en el centro de Puerto Rico, bajo el cuidado de su abuela, una mujer firme y de convicciones conservadoras. La llegada inesperada de su padre Rubén, después de años en prisión, trae consigo una mezcla de alivio por su presencia y complicaciones por las ambigüedades en su relación. Ahora, Carmín se enfrenta a aprender a vivir entre el abandono y la cautela, mientras navega entre la ausencia, el deseo y el amor. La dinámica familiar se entrelaza con los desafíos de su adolescencia, mientras ella busca entender y reconciliar los sentimientos encontrados que surgen con la reaparición de su padre en su vida.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Paraísos naturales se vuelven escenarios de tragedia por empresas informales, guías sin capacitación y falta de control. Vidas como las de José, Liliana y Andrea se apagaron, mientras familias claman justicia y mayor regulación.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Yiset Silva y Lisandro Rodríguez enfrentan un misterio tras el parto de su hija el 31 de diciembre de 2020 en Armenia. La clínica dice que la bebé nació sin vida, pero la familia cree que está viva. Inconsistencias en la historia clínica y una necropsia sin órganos aumentan sus dudas. La Fiscalía investiga.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: A pesar de los esfuerzos para promover el turismo, hay un número creciente de ataques en Colombia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Jhon Ferney, condenado por feminicidio en 2015, muestra los efectos de la celopatía, trastorno originado en la infancia por la falta de afecto. Su historia revela cómo los celos enfermizos y una relación tóxica desembocaron en tragedia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Hogares convertidos en escenarios de violencia. Historias de arrendatarios que ocultan secretos, mientras familias vulnerables enfrentan tragedias impensables. En un país donde el arriendo es necesidad, la confianza se paga con vidas y silencio.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Desde su inicio en 1996, Séptimo Día ha sido un referente del periodismo investigativo en Colombia. Historias arriesgadas, denuncias impactantes y la valentía de sus reporteros han marcado el rumbo de una televisión que no teme confrontar la verdad.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Desde los 12 años, una niña fue abusada por un pariente que luego se convirtió en su asesino. Jorge Alonso, tras evadir a la policía por 7 años y cambiar de identidad, fue capturado y espera juicio en Bucaramanga.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, María Isabel Delgado y su hija Selena desaparecieron en Pasto, Nariño. Tras días de búsqueda, se reveló que Milton, esposo de María Isabel y también su primo, las había asesinado para ocultar que era padre de otra bebé fruto de una relación extramarital secreta. Los cuerpos fueron hallados enterrados con señales de violencia. Milton fue declarado autor intelectual del doble homicidio y condenado a 33 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. La investigación reveló que Andrea, su mejor amiga, la asesinó al descubrir que Jessica sostenía una relación con su esposo, Leimar. Autoridades sospechan que Andrea tuvo cómplices en el crimen. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Óscar es asesinado en su cuarto. Al principio parecía suicidio, pero su amigo Yeison fue arrestado y reveló que la ex esposa, Paola, lo mandó matar por el seguro. Yeison recibe 17 años de cárcel. Paola proclama su inocencia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Juez Mom

En 2004, desaparecieron tras salir con una amiga y fueron hallados acribillados. Sus madres, Inés y Beatriz, llevan 17 años luchando por justicia, enfrentando amenazas mientras buscan la verdad sobre lo ocurrido a sus hijos.

programme.title: Los Informantes

Camilo Herrera, tras quebrar en 2008, fundó "Un Litro de Luz", llevando iluminación solar con botellas recicladas a comunidades de más de 23 países.

programme.desc: David golpeó y estranguló a Whitney, quien quiere probar su fidelidad. Ruby admite engañar a Nathalie. ¿Podrá Steve ayudar a ambas a dejar a sus hombres?

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 8 de marzo de 2010, dos niños fueron hallados muertos en Bogotá. Su madre, Ana Milena Yate, y su pareja, John Edison Zapata, fueron condenados a 60 años por el homicidio. Ambos participaron en el crimen tras una noche de alcohol y violencia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2011, en Anzoátegui, Tolima, los gemelos Diego y Juan Sebastián, de 7 años, fueron secuestrados por Pedro Andrés Laserna, expareja de su madre Mariela, tras ella terminar la relación y denunciarlo por violencia. Laserna exigió dinero y su regreso a cambio de los niños, pero finalmente los asesinó. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por secuestro extorsivo agravado y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Martha Luz creía ciegamente en Jhon Fredy, su pareja, un yerbatero con antecedentes de abuso sexual. Cuando sus hijos Lizbey y Juan Pablo desaparecen en 2010, la policía sospecha del padrastro por su actitud extraña. Los cuerpos aparecen brutalmente asesinados en un río. Jhon confiesa el doble crimen alegando motivos esotéricos, mientras Martha, señalada como cómplice, es condenada como coautora del homicidio de sus propios hijos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Tame, Arauca, un militar fue condenado a 60 años por violar y asesinar brutalmente a tres niños. El Tribunal Superior de Bogotá lo encontró culpable de acceso carnal violento y homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El 17 octubre del 2015, en el corregimiento de Belén, en El Banco Magdalena, dos hombres abusaron y asesinaron a Valeria Peña, una menor de 15 años que logró sobrevivir antes los ataques y dejar un testimonio donde señalaba a José Fernando López como el autor material de su crimen. Sin embargo, un tercer testimonio involucro al hermano de José Fernando y el autor intelectual quien tenía claras intenciones de venganza.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Frank Faruk Rodríguez, se entregó a las autoridades y confeso que asesino a su cuñada y Sofía, su sobrina de seis años. Después de haber confesado el crimen ahora niega los hechos. Finalmente, en junio 13 de 2012, Fran Faruk fue condenado a la pena de 56 años y 3 meses de prisión. Próximamente, se le abrirá un nuevo proceso penal por la conducta sexual contra su sobrina Angie Sofía Guzmán.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: María Elena, vendedora ambulante, es asesinada por su novio Damián tras negarse a abortar su hijo. Su cuerpo es encontrado sin útero.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: El padre franciscano Gabriel Gutiérrez, conocido como "Fray ñero", murió por COVID-19 el 2 de abril. Dedicó su vida a ayudar a habitantes de calle en Bogotá, especialmente tras el desalojo de El Bronx en 2016. Fundó Callejeros de la Misericordia, organización que acompaña a poblaciones vulnerables como vendedores informales, recicladores y trabajadoras sexuales. Su legado de compasión permanece en el centro de la ciudad.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Tres historias: Pirry, reconocido periodista, revela su lucha contra la depresión tras años documentando crímenes como el de Garavito. En Nueva Venecia, niños juegan fútbol sobre una cancha flotante en la Ciénaga Grande, soñando con ser estrellas pese a la pobreza. Y Zach Morris, un youtuber estadounidense, cuenta cómo Colombia se convirtió en su hogar tras años luchando por su nacionalidad.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Édgar Jiménez, "El Chino", fue el fotógrafo de confianza de Pablo Escobar durante casi dos décadas, con acceso íntimo a su vida en la Hacienda Nápoles. Amigo de infancia del capo, documentó desde animales exóticos hasta su campaña política, sobreviviendo a la masacre de "Los Pepes" contra allegados de Escobar. Hoy vive humildemente en Medellín, dejando un archivo gráfico único sobre el narcotráfico colombiano.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he travels deeper into the rugged terrain of the Eastern Cape. Known for their ability to vanish into thick vegetation at the first sign of danger, hunting these "ghosts of the bush" requires extreme patience and precision. programme.title: The Journey Within

Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

This place holds the “old south” feel that is ever so fleeting. We hunt on a property I sold to a client last year in Saint Francisville and manage to get a beautiful longbearded turkey on the ground. This episode is one you definitely don’t want to miss.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive into how we are using our knowledge and experience to not only get some amazing hunting property, but to have other people pay for it. programme.title: Hunting Land Man

Slade takes you through the showing process on a beautiful piece of property and bring it full circle at the closing. You’ll also watch a deer hunt with Slade in Natchez that was featured on Realtree Monster Bucks DVD. This is a jampacked episode with so much to learn and also enjoy. We know you’ll love it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency

So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers

programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Peter Frampton - FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album Frampton Comes Alive!.

programme.title: Michael Bolton - Live at the Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: Join Michael Bolton for an unforgettable concert at London's famous Royal Albert Hall as he delivers hit after hit in his trademark soulful style in front of a packed audience.

programme.title: Andrea Bocelli: Live in Tuscany
programme.desc: Vivere: Live in Tuscany is a concert performed by classical singer Andrea Bocelli.

programme.title: Annie Lennox - An Evening of Nostalgia
programme.desc: An Evening Of Nostalgia with Annie Lennox captures one of music's most popular and acclaimed artists in her only full concert performance of songs from her Grammy-nominated Nostalgia album.

programme.title: Paul Simon - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Avril Lavigne - Live in Calgary
programme.desc: The Canadian Avril Lavigne enchanted the public in 2007 at her show in Calgary (Canada), in which she released the album The Best Damn Thing, which sold, that same year, more than 6 million copies worldwide.

programme.title: Celine Dion - Taking Chances World Tour
programme.desc: Part of the world tour of Celine Dion, which was seen by more than 3 million people and covered 5 continents, 25 countries and 92 cities - the first tour in nine years that was an absolute success.

programme.title: Coldplay - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Supertramp: Breakfast In America: Live in Paris
programme.desc: Supertramp's Breakfast In America was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10-month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November.

programme.title: Rush - Time Machine: Live in Cleveland
programme.desc: Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures,' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centerpiece of the concerts.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner - Live
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. Fred Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass.

programme.title: Jethro Tull - Live at Montreux, 2003
programme.desc: Split into a semi-acoustic first half and a full on electric second half, the concert was a triumph combining newer songs such as Dot Com, Pavane and Budapest with classic favorites. Music video by Jethro Tull © 2003 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Hans Zimmer - Live in Prague
programme.desc: This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Mary J. Blige -- Live in London 2014
programme.desc: Singer Mary J. Blige takes the stage to perform her biggest hits for iTunes Festival at the Roundhouse in London in 2014.

programme.title: Lauryn Hill - Live at Austin City Limits
programme.desc: Grammy-winning singer and songwriter Lauryn Hill performs a set of solo hits, along with Fugees classics.

programme.title: Beck -- Live at Eurockeennes Festival 2016
programme.desc: Discreet genie, it's a Music-Man (with capital Ms) that's coming to Eurockennes. Since Loser in 1993, Beck trims his mix of styles. Sometimes groove, sometimes soft, sometimes rock, psyched or hip-hop.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance the album Days of Future Passed.

programme.title: Nirvana - Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: This film features powerful footage of Nirvana in action, both in concert and in the studio. In addition, we hear from a team of leading music critics and insiders including Miti Adhikari, Kurt Cobain's biographer Charles R. Cross.

programme.title: David Gilmour - Remember That Night

programme.title: Paramore - Live at the Roundhouse

programme.title: Carlos Santana - Greatest Hits: Live at Montreux 2011

programme.title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week’s episode of Artist Friendly, we’re bringing back Joel Madden’s conversation with Bert McCracken of The Used. Fresh off his first solo pop album and living in Sydney with his wife and two daughters, Bert talks with Joel about the pop music he’s always loved, the frontman on stage vs. the dad at home, how loss and grief have shaped his songwriting, and what it means to be happy.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Taylor Goldsmith, frontman of the acclaimed band Dawes, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation about balancing happiness with ambition, the search for meaning in success, and the band’s latest album, Oh Brother. Goldsmith reflects on songwriting, self-growth, and the wisdom learned through years of making music.

programme.title: Phantogram: Live at the Hollywood Palladium Los Angeles
programme.desc: Phantogram perform a sold-out Running Through Colors Tour set at the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles. Highlights include “Mouthful of Diamonds” and “Fall in Love.”

programme.title: Flogging Molly: Shamrock Rebellion Live from Las Vegas
programme.desc: Flogging Molly headline Shamrock Rebellion, a Saint Patrick’s Day celebration live from Las Vegas, Nevada. Featuring a high-energy set of Celtic punk anthems and performances from Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls, the concert captures the spirit of punk unity, rebellion, and Irish pride.

programme.title: Future Islands: Live From Cat's Cradle
programme.desc: Future Islands stream live from Cat’s Cradle, celebrating 20 years from a room filled with memories.

programme.title: Foo Fighters: Live at Wembley Stadium
programme.desc: Filmed over two sold-out nights at England's largest arena, Live At Wembley Stadium features your favorite Foo Fighters hits, from "Everlong" to "The Pretender," plus special guest appearances by Jimmy Page and John Paul Jones of Led Zeppelin

programme.title: Poppy: Live at House of Blues in Anaheim
programme.desc: Poppy performs live at House of Blues Anaheim on the second leg of her “They’re All Around Us” Tour. This concert capture features dark, industrial-tinged themes and high-intensity vocals.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: In this episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Grammy Award-winning singer and songwriter Tori Kelly to talk about her new self-titled album TORI and her upcoming tour. Kelly opens up about artistic evolution, learning to embrace fun and authenticity in her 30s, and the creative freedom she found working with producer Jon Bellion. From her viral YouTube beginnings to her renewed confidence as a performer, Tori reflects on her journey, her faith, and the balance between art and commerce in the music industry.

programme.title: Oasis: Live by the Sea
programme.desc: Oasis performs a 1995 concert in Southend, delivering early hits like Live Forever and Supersonic as they rise to international fame.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy: So Much For (2our) Dust Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: Recorded at the iconic Madison Square Garden, So Much For (2our) Dust captures Fall Out Boy delivering an electrifying performance filled with emotion, energy, and nostalgia. With a setlist that spans their entire career — from early emo anthems to their latest hits — the band’s signature blend of heartfelt lyrics and explosive showmanship takes center stage. Between songs, frontman Pete Wentz shares raw reflections on loss, creativity, and the band’s improbable journey from punk clubs to arena stardom, making this concert a powerful chronicle of endurance and connection.

programme.title: Paul Weller on Wild Wood
programme.desc: Paul Weller reflects on creating Wild Wood and his early-’90s reinvention. The film explores his analog shift and key tracks “Wild Wood,” “Sunflower,” and “Moon on Your Pyjamas.”

programme.title: Liam Gallagher: Live at Knebworth
programme.desc: Liam Gallagher of Oasis gives 160,000 fans hope through his music at Knebworth. Known as 'the King of Knebworth', he delivers joy.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji Madden and Avenged Sevenfold’s M. Shadows reflect on 25 years of friendship and creativity in a candid conversation with Artist Friendly.

programme.title: Metal From the Dirt: Rez Metal on the Navajo Nation
programme.desc: Navajo (Diné) musicians and scene builders trace the rise of Rez Metal, from generator-powered desert shows to Hogan rehearsals, blending heavy music with culture, pride, and survival.

programme.title: Nobody's Gonna Do It For You: Ten Years of Sincere Engineer
programme.desc: Sincere Engineer reflects on ten years of wild journey, recognizing the village that helped raise it and thanking fans and friends.

programme.title: An Evening of Bell House Debuts
programme.desc: Hosted by Chris Gethard, this Brooklyn showcase features emerging stand-ups connecting with a community of rising talent in a live comedy debut series.

programme.title: Dropkick Murphys: St. Patrick’s Day 2024 Live from Boston
programme.desc: Dropkick Murphys return home to Boston for their annual St. Patrick’s Day concert at the MGM Music Hall at Fenway, performing fan favorites like “The Boys Are Back,” “The State of Massachusetts,” “Queen of Suffolk County,” and “Johnny, I Hardly Knew Ya.” With surprise guest Billy Bragg opening the show, plus appearances by Kneecap and Pennywise, the night captures the fierce pride, Celtic punk energy, and hometown spirit that define the band’s legacy.

programme.title: In Conversation Lucy Dacus and Katie Gavin
programme.desc: Dacus and Gavin chat in LA, discussing Dacus's new record and their friendship, filled with giggles.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multitalented comedian, musician, and author Reggie Watts joins Joel Madden to discuss his creative evolution—from growing up in Montana to shaping the alt-comedy and music scenes in Seattle, New York, and Los Angeles. Watts reflects on his improvisational approach, performing in countless bands, and his Veeps comedy special Never Mind, revealing how curiosity and playfulness drive his art.

programme.title: Kings of Leon: Live at The O2 London, England
programme.desc: Kings of Leon performs live at The O2 in London, delivering hits like Sex on Fire and Use Somebody in a high-energy set.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Carly Pearce on Artist Friendly. Pearce reflects on leaving high school at 16 for Dollywood, moving to Nashville at 19, and years of grinding before her breakthrough. She opens up about trusting her instincts, turning heartbreak into Grammy-winning music, and making peace with the hardest chapters of her story.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Oasis: Standing on the Edge of the Noise
programme.desc: Oasis performs an intimate rehearsal set at Black Island Studios, featuring tracks from Dig Out Your Soul alongside classics and rarities.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy calls off “spin the bottle” when the puppets’ gross habits come to light, launching a chaotic crash course in hygiene and self-care. A parody round of Is It Cake? serves up a shocking twist, Detective Poppy makes a noir-style debut to hunt down a nasty rumor about Mr. Skip, and Zwink gets a spa day that tackles stink and sadness—ending with a catchy cleanliness anthem. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Jimmy Eat World: 20th Anniversary of “Futures” Live From Phoenix
programme.desc: Jimmy Eat World return to their hometown for a one-night celebration of the 20th anniversary of Futures, performing the album front to back at The Van Buren in Phoenix, Arizona. Featuring fan-favorite tracks (“Futures,” “Just Tonight…,” “Work,” “The World You Love,” “Pain,” “Drugs or Me”) and special hometown moments from the band.

programme.title: Forte
programme.desc: Forte challenges outdated notions of success in classical music through the fast-paced narrative of three female artists.

programme.title: Billy Idol: State Line Live at the Hoover Dam
programme.desc: Punk icon Billy Idol makes history with the first-ever concert at the Hoover Dam, performing alongside longtime collaborator Steve Stevens and his band. This landmark event blends raw rock energy with stunning desert visuals and intimate acoustic moments. Featuring special guests Alison Mosshart (The Kills), Steve Jones (Sex Pistols), and Tony Kanal (No Doubt.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Backstreet Boys: Homecoming - Live In Orlando
programme.desc: Backstreet Boys returns to Orlando for a 1999 homecoming concert, performing hits like As Long As You Love Me and Everybody (Backstreet’s Back).

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Mae Martin: "I'm a TV"
programme.desc: Mae Martin’s I’m a TV, captured live in Los Angeles. Blending intimate indie-pop songs with witty onstage banter, Mae performs new material on the eve of the album’s release and sharing stories that inspired tracks like “Say the Word,” “Try Me,” “Don’t Get Tired of Me,” and “Garbage Strike.” A confessional, funny, and heartfelt set about love, reinvention, and finding calm in the chaos.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Mikaela Hoover discusses art and life on Artist Friendly, sharing personal insights and her pride in her wife's company, House of Harlow.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Professor Poppy turns “school” upside down: a fractions lesson with a jewel-cam and a reality-bending sync glitch spirals into a nightmare of beans; a hands-on grip tutorial earns Poppy her union card; and dueling magicians escalate their rivalry from stage tricks to existential dread—before Poppy closes with a catchy lesson-on-learning performance. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Benji & Joel Madden / Cameron Diaz & Katherine Power: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji and Joel Madden share their journey into artist management, while Cameron Diaz and Katherine Power discuss building their organic wine brand, Avaline.

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Nightclubbing: The Birth of Punk Rock in NYC
programme.desc: Nightclubbing is the first ever documentary about the renowned New York City nightclub Max's Kansas City (1965-1981) which had an indelible impact on the world of music, fashion, art, culture and the creation of the New York City Punk Rock scene

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: Symphonic Metal Epicness
programme.desc: Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Metalcore Madness
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate pit. Metalcore Madness brings you the visual pulse of metalcore and deathcore—packed with blistering solos, heavy breakdowns, and raw energy. Turn it up, open the pit, and let the madness take over!

programme.title: Progressive Metal Laboratory
programme.desc: A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

programme.title: Night Time Metal
programme.desc: The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.

programme.title: For Metalheads Only
programme.desc: Leave the rock anthems at the door—this is 100% pure steel. We’ve dialed the distortion to eleven for a lineup strictly for the heavy-duty fans. No compromises, no fillers, just total sonic devastation.

programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Symphonies Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Violin Concerto, Op. 35
programme.desc: Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.

programme.title: Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programme.title: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.

programme.title: Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in Dvorák's Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 5-8); recorded at St. Luke's, London.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Gianandrea Noseda conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73 ('Emperor'), featuring Beatrice Rana as the soloist. Recorded at Barbican Hall in London, UK, in 2022.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Edusei Conducts Mendelssohn, Schumann & Boulanger
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and led the orchestra in a performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's "A Midsummer Night's Dream" and more.

programme.title: Schubert -- Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of "Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944" by Franz Schubert.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, "Little Russian."

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
Galaxmphony - The Final Odyssey
programme.desc: The DR Symphony Orchestra breaks the sound barrier and takes you out into the galaxies - to a place between reality and fantasy with soundtracks from Star Wars, The Mandalorian, Star Trek, Dune and many more.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Mozart Clarinet Concerto in A Major
programme.desc: Belgian clarinettist Geert Baeckelandt performs with Casco Phil, under the baton of Benjamin Haemhouts.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: El 24 de agosto de 1882 Ana Ensenyat moriría en su domicilio del municipio de Andratx, Mallorca, tras ser envenenada con arsénico.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Febrero de 2013. Un joven de 18 años mata a su madre en Palma golpeándola salvajemente con una marcuerna. Fue el final de una cruel historia de maltrato familiar reflejada en un diario localizado por los investigadores y escrito por la víctima, María Luisa Perún, durante sus últimos meses de vida.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Tina Gardner piensa que está destinada a la grandeza. Conoce a Andre, quien le pide que lo ayude a lanzar un nuevo negocio, y juntos conquistan Las Vegas.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Los adolescentes Tamara y Leo se ven obligados a casarse cuando Tamara queda embarazada, pero la presión de criar una familia los separa.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Después de dos relaciones fallidas, Michelle Covington es conquistada por un antiguo compañero de clase de la secundaria.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Una joven marcada por traumas de la infancia lucha por reconstruir su vida. Conoce al hombre de sus sueños, pero una vez comprometidos, la relación de la pareja se desmorona.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Año 1992. El descubrimiento en un acantilado de la costa de Mallorca de un cadáver decapitado es el punto de partida de una investigación policial que destapará la realidad que se esconde detrás del asesinato ejecutado por una red de narcotraficantes vinculados a los cárteles colombianos de la droga.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Año 1992. El descubrimiento en un acantilado de la costa de Mallorca de un cadáver decapitado es el punto de partida de una investigación policial que destapará la realidad que se esconde detrás del asesinato ejecutado por una red de narcotraficantes vinculados a los cárteles colombianos de la droga.

programme.title: Memoria Negra
programme.desc: Año 2006. Katerina Buchler es asesinada de un disparo en su domicilio de Cala Murada, Mallorca. Su marido, Rudolf Eberhard, era el único testigo de los hechos. En su declaración aseguró que el crimen había ocurrido durante un robo con violencia en la casa. La investigación policial destapó la realidad del caso.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Donna, una madre soltera de cuatro hijos en la ciudad de Nueva York, es una trabajadora auxiliar de enfermería que desesperadamente quiere un esposo y una figura paterna para sus hijos.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Lori se sintió no amada y torpe durante su infancia.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Una joven hermosa pero desorientada se convierte en stripper y termina arruinando públicamente su reputación. El incidente conduce a una serie de malas relaciones hasta que una noche apuñala a su amante durante una pelea física y termina en la cárcel.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Una conexión instantánea en un gimnasio lleva a Jamie, una hermosa joven madre de dos hijos, a enamorarse de Charlie, un hombre enérgico y mujeriego amante de los clubes nocturnos.

programme.title: Wives With Knives (español)
programme.desc: Sarah Saunders, de 15 años, es una madre soltera incapaz de asumir completamente la responsabilidad de criar a un hijo sola.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: Martes, 11 de octubre de 2005. Eric Boisseranc regresa a su casa, en Chazay d'Azergues, un pequeño pueblo del Beaujolais.

programme.title: Contra Reloj

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey viajan a Inglaterra para traer un nuevo avión a casa.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe vuela con los Snowbirds durante el espectáculo aéreo de Hamilton y luego enseña a Mikey a volar.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebra un hito con una mirada a los últimos cinco años, un vistazo detrás de cámaras y reflexiones de la tripulación de Buffalo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un incendio en el motor y una serie de fallas mecánicas hacen que Buffalo se apresure para realizar sus entregas de Navidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El avión Electra de Buffalo enfrenta fuertes vientos en el valle del Mackenzie.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Problemas en el motor afectan al nuevo Electra de Buffalo, ZFE, y un enfrentamiento entre Joe y Transport Canada amenaza con cerrar la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe se va a realizar pruebas médicas en la Clínica Mayo en Phoenix, Arizona.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto novato Jeff casi se sale de la pista.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey decide involucrar a Buffalo en un salto de paracaidistas para conmemorar el 70º aniversario del Día D.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los mejores pilotos de Buffalo, tanto novatos como veteranos, viajan a California para combates aéreos en aviones de combate reales.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El homenaje de Mikey al Día D, un salto en paracaídas con 20 paracaidistas, encuentra un obstáculo cuando Joe se niega a pilotar su DC-3 hasta la zona de salto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La Navidad está a la vuelta de la esquina, pero la comida y el correo cruciales de Buffalo se detienen. Una incautación del motor deja a Scott, AJ y el avión C-46, creando una reacción en cadena caótica. El crujiente mecánico Chuck debe intentar un cambio de motor con las manos desnudas en menos 30, y la presión de los clientes y compañeros de trabajo empuja al gerente de carga Kelly.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un furioso Joe lucha contra una suspensión federal que le impedirá transportar pasajeros por primera vez en 20 años. También es un revés para Jeremy y las otras rampas, que empeora con una lesión inesperada. Para el equipo de waterbomber de Turquía, finalmente es una oportunidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe pelea una demanda de Transport Canada contra la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando un incendio mortal destruye un puesto de avanzada en el norte una semana antes de Navidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La maldición del -40 golpea a los pilotos de Buffalo, Devan y Scott, en un vuelo por correo de alimentos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey va en busca del tesoro a Venezuela en busca de un raro waterbomber CL-215.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un enlace de ferry vital está caído, por lo que Buffalo organiza una campaña total para transportar 100,000 libras de productos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico crujiente Chuck lidera la lucha para preparar a los Electra para una misión de socorro en casos de desastre en Haití.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una misión de varias paradas al Extremo Norte tiene a Devan, Scott y Adam enfrentando una serie de obstáculos de nudillos blancos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los jóvenes pilotos AJ y Andrew tienen la oportunidad de su vida de volar el magnífico DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo obtiene la carta de su vida cuando se les pide que transporten la Copa Stanley en una gira por el Norte.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto principal Arnie aterriza el DC-3 en una franja de arena casera en un refugio remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando las tormentas eléctricas y un motor tembloroso amenazan un alquiler de DC-3 a Whitehorse.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey se dirigen a Coventry, Inglaterra, para explorar la posible compra de un turbohélice Electra.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mientras entrena a los capitanes de bombas de agua para la próxima temporada de extinción de incendios.
